# Phase 6A: Utilities (`/rank`, `/boss-tier`, `/maps`, `/find-gym`, `/request`): Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Members rank a Pokémon's IVs for PvP (also in a DM with the bot), ask whether a Pokémon is a raid boss now, get the link to the region map, look up a gym, and send a request about a gym to the maintainers as a GitHub issue.

**Architecture:** Phase 6 (utilities) is two plans: 6A (this one, no new outside service but GitHub) and 6B (`/counters` with Pokebattler, `/find-region` with Nominatim). The PvP maths is pure (`src/domain/pvp/`) over the game master's CP multipliers; the game master parser gains each Pokémon's evolutions. `/boss-tier` reads `ctx.raidBosses`; `/find-gym` and `/request` share the gym option of this server's gyms (`src/commands/util/server-gym.ts`); GitHub sits behind a port (`ctx.issues`).

**Tech Stack:** TypeScript 6.0, discord.js 14.27, Kysely on MySQL, Vitest. No new dependencies, no migration. `GAME_DATA_VERSION` 5: the first start downloads the game data again.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-09-typescript-discordjs-migration-design.md`: rows 190 and 198 to 200 of 4.2, 6.3 (pvpivs). The design brief is the git-ignored `.superpowers/sdd/phase-6-design.md`; the rulings are in `.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-14-phase-6a-utilities/`; what the legacy bot did is `.superpowers/sdd/phase-6-legacy-notes.txt`.

**Every diff in this plan was run before the plan was written**, on a throwaway branch (`proto/phase-6a`), one commit per task, with the typecheck and the tests of each task clean and the full check, build and database suite clean on the tip (4,608 unit tests; the database suite, 294 tests). Two reviewers went through that branch and a third through the fixes; what they found is already in the code below.

## Decisions made in this plan (the controller's rulings overnight; Matt has not seen them)

1. **`/rank pokemon attack defense stamina [league] [filter] [evolutions]`**: great (default), ultra, master, little; filters ultra friend, best friend, raid, lucky; in the PvP category (public) or a DM with the bot. Ranked at the level-50 cap, and level 51 (best buddy) shown too only when its rank or best IVs differ (the legacy pair was 51 and 40). Rank by stat product, then IV sum, then CP; equal combinations share a rank. The evolution line (what the Pokémon evolves into, recursively) in the description. Megas and primals refused. A link to pvpivs.com.
2. **`/boss-tier [pokemon]`**: from the current boss list (never the legacy columns): which tiers a Pokémon is a boss of now, other forms of it that are, and without a Pokémon the whole list as members see it.
3. **`/maps`**: the link of `settings.regionMapLink` (a setting now, not an environment variable; blank is unset), privately, also in a DM.
4. **`/find-gym gym`** (members get a gym look-up, as the legacy `find-gym`): the member's view of a gym of this server (no staff details).
5. **`/request text [gym]`**: from a raid's post (or a train's current stop, or with `gym`), 3 per 30 minutes, a GitHub issue through `GITHUB_TOKEN` and `GITHUB_REPO` (the token needs push access for the gym-number label); mentions and issue links in the text are broken; the member is told whether it arrived.

## Global Constraints

- Read `CLAUDE.md` first; its hard rules apply: never push, never start the bot or contact Discord, never edit legacy JS or the legacy `data/*.json` files. Never read, print or stage `.env`.
- Node 24, TypeScript **6.0.x**, ESM only; `.js` in relative imports; `strict`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`; no `any` without a justifying comment.
- `src/domain/` stays pure. Tests never use the network. The GitHub token is never logged.
- Each task carries the full diff of the prototype commit it transcribes (branch `proto/phase-6a`). Apply it exactly; `git diff <that commit> -- src test scripts .env.example` must print nothing before the task is committed.
- A task needs the typecheck and its own tests green; the full `npm run check` after the last task. `npx prettier --write` on touched files.
- Commit after every task with the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`, as `Matt Legowski <googer@pobox.com>`; stage by explicit path; never `.idea/`, `var/`, `.env`; no title starting with a slash.

## Review Focus

1. The PvP ranks match an independent brute force (reviewer A compared 20 Pokémon × 4 leagues × 2 caps × 3 floors) and equal combinations share a rank (Carkol, Bulbasaur tests).
2. No other server's gym is ever shown or accepted by `/find-gym` and `/request`, also by bare digits.
3. Nothing in a GitHub issue pings or links anybody; the token stays in the header.
4. Every answer fits Discord's limits (Eevee's whole line in Master League).

### Task 1: PvP ranking of IVs, and the evolutions of every Pokemon

Prototype commit: `ecc154edccb82e14738396041c032f8910cef24d`

The game master parser reads evolutionBranch into PokemonEntry.evolutions
(the keys an entry evolves into directly; megas and targets the game master
lacks are left out), and the catalogue gives an entry's evolution line.
GAME_DATA_VERSION is 5.

src/domain/pvp/rank.ts ranks all IV combinations of a Pokemon in a league:
CP multipliers rounded to 32-bit floats with half levels between, each
combination at its highest level within the league up to level 50 or 51,
by stat product, then IV sum, then CP, with a floor for trades and raids.

````diff
+  /**

+  evolutionLine(entry: PokemonEntry): PokemonEntry[] {

+      if (seen.has(one.key)) return;
+      seen.add(one.key);

+      }
+    };
+    visit(entry);
+    return line;

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..173a90a0087c2f2d8e9e0f50d03469a4381cb41b

@@ -0,0 +1,182 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { catalogueFixture } from '../../../test/support/game-data.js';
+import { combatPower } from '../pogo/cp.js';
+import type { PokemonEntry } from '../pogo/game-master.js';
+import { pvpMultipliers, pvpRank, rankedSpreads, type RankOptions } from './rank.js';
+
+const catalogue = catalogueFixture();
+const multipliers = pvpMultipliers(catalogue.cpMultipliers, 51);
+
+function stats(key: string): PokemonEntry['stats'] {
+  const found = catalogue.byKey(key);
+  if (!found) throw new Error(`no entry ${key}`);
+  return found.stats;
+}
+
+const GREAT: RankOptions = { leagueCp: 1500, levelCap: 50, floor: 0 };
+
+describe('pvpMultipliers', () => {
+  it('has every level from 1 to the cap in steps of a half', () => {
+    expect(multipliers).toHaveLength(101);
+    expect(pvpMultipliers(catalogue.cpMultipliers, 50)).toHaveLength(99);
+  });
+
+  it('rounds whole levels to 32-bit floats and takes half levels from those', () => {
+    const [first = 0, second = 0] = catalogue.cpMultipliers;
+    expect(multipliers[0]).toBe(Math.fround(first));
+    expect(multipliers[2]).toBe(Math.fround(second));
+    expect(multipliers[1]).toBe(
+      Math.sqrt((Math.fround(first) ** 2 + Math.fround(second) ** 2) / 2),
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('refuses a level the game master does not list', () => {
+    expect(() => pvpMultipliers([0.1, 0.2], 3)).toThrow(RangeError);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('rankedSpreads', () => {
+  const spreads = rankedSpreads(stats('mewtwo'), multipliers, GREAT);
+
+  it('ranks all 4,096 combinations', () => {
+    expect(spreads).toHaveLength(4096);
+  });
+
+  it('puts each combination at the highest level within the league and the level cap', () => {
+    for (const spread of spreads) {
+      expect(spread.cp).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1500);
+      expect(spread.level).toBeLessThanOrEqual(50);
+      const above = multipliers[spread.level * 2 - 1];
+      if (spread.level < 50 && above !== undefined) {
+        expect(combatPower(stats('mewtwo'), spread.ivs, above)).toBeGreaterThan(1500);
+      }
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('computes CP and the stats in battle as the game does', () => {
+    const [best] = spreads;
+    if (!best) throw new Error('no spread');
+    const multiplier = multipliers[best.level * 2 - 2] ?? 0;
+    const base = stats('mewtwo');
+    expect(best.cp).toBe(combatPower(base, best.ivs, multiplier));
+    expect(best.attack).toBe((base.attack + best.ivs.attack) * multiplier);
+    expect(best.defense).toBe((base.defense + best.ivs.defense) * multiplier);
+    expect(best.hp).toBe(Math.floor((base.stamina + best.ivs.stamina) * multiplier));
+    expect(best.product).toBeCloseTo(best.attack * best.defense * best.hp, 3);
+    expect(best.product).toBe(
+      multiplier *
+        multiplier *
+        ((base.attack + best.ivs.attack) * (base.defense + best.ivs.defense) * best.hp),
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('orders by stat product, then by the sum of the IVs, then by CP', () => {
+    const sum = ({ ivs }: { ivs: { attack: number; defense: number; stamina: number } }) =>
+      ivs.attack + ivs.defense + ivs.stamina;
+    for (let i = 1; i < spreads.length; i += 1) {
+      const [a, b] = [spreads[i - 1], spreads[i]];
+      if (!a || !b) continue;
+      expect(a.product).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(b.product);
+      if (a.product === b.product) {
+        expect(sum(a)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(sum(b));
+        if (sum(a) === sum(b)) expect(a.cp).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(b.cp);
+      }
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('ranks only the combinations at or above the floor', () => {
+    const raid = rankedSpreads(stats('mewtwo'), multipliers, { ...GREAT, floor: 10 });
+    expect(raid).toHaveLength(216);
+    const lowest = ({ attack, defense, stamina }: (typeof raid)[number]['ivs']) =>
+      Math.min(attack, defense, stamina);
+    expect(raid.every((spread) => lowest(spread.ivs) >= 10)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('leaves out what is above the league already at level 1', () => {
+    expect(rankedSpreads(stats('mewtwo'), multipliers, { ...GREAT, leagueCp: 10 })).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('ranks 4,096 combinations in well under 100 ms', () => {
+    rankedSpreads(stats('azumarill'), multipliers, { ...GREAT, levelCap: 51 });
+    const started = performance.now();
+    for (const key of ['mewtwo', 'azumarill', 'medicham', 'registeel']) {
+      rankedSpreads(stats(key), multipliers, { ...GREAT, levelCap: 51 });
+    }
+    expect((performance.now() - started) / 4).toBeLessThan(100);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('pvpRank', () => {
+  it('gives combinations that are equal in everything the same rank', () => {
+    // Carkol's two best combinations have the same product, IV sum and CP.
+    const rankOf = (attack: number, defense: number, stamina: number) =>
+      pvpRank(stats('carkol'), multipliers, { attack, defense, stamina }, GREAT)?.rank;
+    expect(rankOf(0, 13, 14)).toBe(1);
+    expect(rankOf(0, 14, 13)).toBe(1);
+    expect(rankOf(0, 15, 12)).toBe(3);
+  });
+
+  it('sees products that are equal in whole numbers as equal, whatever the rounding', () => {
+    // Both at level 50 with 1179 CP and an IV sum of 31; (A+a)(D+d)hp is 1,794,780 for both.
+    const rankOf = (attack: number, defense: number, stamina: number) =>
+      pvpRank(stats('bulbasaur'), multipliers, { attack, defense, stamina }, GREAT)?.rank;
+    expect(rankOf(12, 7, 12)).toBe(rankOf(12, 6, 13));
+  });
+
+  it('in Master League, puts 15/15/15 first at the level cap', () => {
+    const master = { leagueCp: undefined, levelCap: 50, floor: 0 } as const;
+    const perfect = { attack: 15, defense: 15, stamina: 15 };
+    const ranked = pvpRank(stats('dragonite'), multipliers, perfect, master);
+    expect(ranked).toMatchObject({ rank: 1, of: 4096, percent: 100 });
+    expect(ranked?.spread.level).toBe(50);
+    expect(
+      pvpRank(stats('dragonite'), multipliers, perfect, { ...master, levelCap: 51 })?.spread.level,
+    ).toBe(51);
+  });
+
+  it('gives the rank, the share of the best product and the best combination', () => {
+    const ivs = { attack: 10, defense: 12, stamina: 13 };
+    const ranked = pvpRank(stats('mewtwo'), multipliers, ivs, GREAT);
+    const spreads = rankedSpreads(stats('mewtwo'), multipliers, GREAT);
+    const index = spreads.findIndex((spread) => JSON.stringify(spread.ivs) === JSON.stringify(ivs));
+    expect(ranked?.rank).toBe(index + 1);
+    expect(ranked?.best).toEqual(spreads[0]);
+    expect(ranked?.percent).toBeCloseTo(
+      ((spreads[index]?.product ?? 0) / (spreads[0]?.product ?? 1)) * 100,
+      10,
+    );
+    expect(pvpRank(stats('mewtwo'), multipliers, spreads[0]?.ivs ?? ivs, GREAT)?.rank).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it('counts among the combinations of the floor only', () => {
+    const ranked = pvpRank(
+      stats('mewtwo'),
+      multipliers,
+      { attack: 10, defense: 12, stamina: 13 },
+      { ...GREAT, floor: 10 },
+    );
+    expect(ranked?.of).toBe(216);
+  });
+
+  it('refuses IVs below the floor', () => {
+    expect(() =>
+      pvpRank(
+        stats('mewtwo'),
+        multipliers,
+        { attack: 9, defense: 12, stamina: 13 },
+        { ...GREAT, floor: 10 },
+      ),
+    ).toThrow(RangeError);
+  });
+
+  it('is undefined for a combination that cannot be in the league', () => {
+    expect(
+      pvpRank(
+        stats('mewtwo'),
+        multipliers,
+        { attack: 15, defense: 15, stamina: 15 },
+        { ...GREAT, leagueCp: 10 },
+      ),
+    ).toBeUndefined();
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/domain/pvp/rank.ts b/src/domain/pvp/rank.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a903b0a9fa8db6155eeb2cbbb886d8430ff454ab
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/domain/pvp/rank.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,212 @@
+import { combatPower, type Ivs } from '../pogo/cp.js';
+import type { PokemonEntry } from '../pogo/game-master.js';
+
+/** The leagues of Go Battle League and the CP each allows; Master League has no limit. */
+export const LEAGUES = ['little', 'great', 'ultra', 'master'] as const;
+export type League = (typeof LEAGUES)[number];
+
+export const LEAGUE_CP: Readonly<Record<League, number | undefined>> = {
+  little: 500,
+  great: 1500,
+  ultra: 2500,
+  master: undefined,
+};
+
+export const LEAGUE_NAMES: Readonly<Record<League, string>> = {
+  little: 'Little League',
+  great: 'Great League',
+  ultra: 'Ultra League',
+  master: 'Master League',
+};
+
+/**
+ * The lowest IV a Pokémon can have by how it was got: traded between ultra or best friends, a
+ * raid, research or egg catch, a lucky trade. `none` is any Pokémon.
+ */
+export const IV_FLOORS = ['none', 'ultra-friend', 'best-friend', 'raid', 'lucky'] as const;
+export type IvFloor = (typeof IV_FLOORS)[number];
+
+export const IV_FLOOR_VALUE: Readonly<Record<IvFloor, number>> = {
+  none: 0,
+  'ultra-friend': 3,
+  'best-friend': 5,
+  raid: 10,
+  lucky: 12,
+};
+
+export const IV_FLOOR_NAMES: Readonly<Record<IvFloor, string>> = {
+  none: 'None',
+  'ultra-friend': 'Ultra friend trade',
+  'best-friend': 'Best friend trade',
+  raid: 'Raid, egg or research',
+  lucky: 'Lucky trade',
+};
+
+/**
+ * The highest level a Pokémon can be powered up to with XL candy (50), and with a best buddy's
+ * boost (51). The legacy bot's level 40 is no longer the common cap (ruling, plan 6A).
+ */
+export const LEVEL_CAPS = [50, 51] as const;
+export type LevelCap = (typeof LEVEL_CAPS)[number];
+
+/** The highest IV of a stat. */
+export const MAX_IV = 15;
+
+/**
+ * The CP multiplier of every level from 1 to `maxLevel` in steps of a half; index `2 * level -
+ * 2`. A whole level's multiplier is the game master's rounded to a 32-bit float, as the game
+ * keeps it; a half level's is the root mean square of its neighbours (the legacy bot's formula,
+ * which matches the game's values to the CP).
+ */
+export function pvpMultipliers(cpMultipliers: readonly number[], maxLevel: number): number[] {
+  const whole = cpMultipliers.slice(0, maxLevel).map((value) => Math.fround(value));
+  if (whole.length < maxLevel) throw new RangeError(`No CP multiplier for level ${maxLevel}`);
+  const levels: number[] = [];
+  whole.forEach((value, index) => {
+    levels.push(value);
+    const next = whole[index + 1];
+    if (next !== undefined) levels.push(Math.sqrt((value * value + next * next) / 2));
+  });
+  return levels;
+}
+
+/** The level of an index of `pvpMultipliers`. */
+const levelAt = (index: number): number => index / 2 + 1;
+
+/** One combination of IVs at the highest level it may have in a league. */
+export interface Spread {
+  ivs: Ivs;
+  level: number;
+  cp: number;
+  /** The stats in battle: attack and defense to two places, whole hit points. */
+  attack: number;
+  defense: number;
+  hp: number;
+  /** Attack × defense × hit points: what the ranking is by. */
+  product: number;
+}
+
+export interface RankOptions {
+  /** The CP the league allows; undefined for none. */
+  leagueCp: number | undefined;
+  levelCap: LevelCap;
+  /** The lowest IV of each stat; combinations below it are not ranked. */
+  floor: number;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Every combination of IVs from `floor` to 15, each at the highest level up to `levelCap` at
+ * which its CP is within the league, best first: by stat product, then by the sum of the IVs,
+ * then by CP. A combination whose CP is above the league's already at level 1 is left out.
+ * `multipliers` is `pvpMultipliers(…, levelCap)` or longer.
+ */
+export function rankedSpreads(
+  stats: PokemonEntry['stats'],
+  multipliers: readonly number[],
+  options: RankOptions,
+): Spread[] {
+  const top = Math.min(multipliers.length, options.levelCap * 2 - 1) - 1;
+  const spreads: Spread[] = [];
+  for (let attack = options.floor; attack <= MAX_IV; attack += 1) {
+    for (let defense = options.floor; defense <= MAX_IV; defense += 1) {
+      for (let stamina = options.floor; stamina <= MAX_IV; stamina += 1) {
+        const ivs = { attack, defense, stamina };
+        const index = highestLevel(stats, ivs, multipliers, top, options.leagueCp);
+        if (index === undefined) continue;
+        const multiplier = multipliers[index] ?? 0;
+        const spreadAttack = (stats.attack + attack) * multiplier;
+        const spreadDefense = (stats.defense + defense) * multiplier;
+        const hp = Math.floor((stats.stamina + stamina) * multiplier);
+        spreads.push({
+          ivs,
+          level: levelAt(index),
+          cp: combatPower(stats, ivs, multiplier),
+          attack: spreadAttack,
+          defense: spreadDefense,
+          hp,
+          // The whole numbers first: products that are equal stay equal to the last bit, so
+          // the tie-breaks decide between them, not rounding.
+          product:
+            multiplier * multiplier * ((stats.attack + attack) * (stats.defense + defense) * hp),
+        });
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return spreads.sort(betterFirst);
+}
+
+/** The order of the ranking: negative when `a` is better than `b`, zero when they are equal. */
+function betterFirst(a: Spread, b: Spread): number {
+  return b.product - a.product || ivSum(b.ivs) - ivSum(a.ivs) || b.cp - a.cp;
+}
+
+const ivSum = (ivs: Ivs): number => ivs.attack + ivs.defense + ivs.stamina;
+
+/** The index of the highest level up to `top` within the league's CP; CP grows with the level. */
+function highestLevel(
+  stats: PokemonEntry['stats'],
+  ivs: Ivs,
+  multipliers: readonly number[],
+  top: number,
+  leagueCp: number | undefined,
+): number | undefined {
+  const fits = (index: number): boolean =>
+    leagueCp === undefined || combatPower(stats, ivs, multipliers[index] ?? 0) <= leagueCp;
+  if (fits(top)) return top;
+  if (!fits(0)) return undefined;
+  let low = 0;
+  let high = top;
+  // fits(low) and not fits(high)
+  while (high - low > 1) {
+    const middle = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
+    if (fits(middle)) low = middle;
+    else high = middle;
+  }
+  return low;
+}
+
+/** Where one combination of IVs stands among all of a Pokémon's in a league. */
+export interface PvpRank {
+  /** 1 is the best; combinations equal in everything ranked by share a rank. */
+  rank: number;
+  /** How many combinations were ranked: 4,096 without a floor. */
+  of: number;
+  /** The combination's stat product as a share of the best's, in percent. */
+  percent: number;
+  spread: Spread;
+  best: Spread;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The rank of `ivs` among the combinations `rankedSpreads` ranks; undefined when the
+ * combination cannot be in the league at any level (its CP is too high already at level 1).
+ * The IVs must not be below the floor.
+ */
+export function pvpRank(
+  stats: PokemonEntry['stats'],
+  multipliers: readonly number[],
+  ivs: Ivs,
+  options: RankOptions,
+): PvpRank | undefined {
+  if (Math.min(ivs.attack, ivs.defense, ivs.stamina) < options.floor) {
+    throw new RangeError('The IVs are below the floor');
+  }
+  const spreads = rankedSpreads(stats, multipliers, options);
+  const index = spreads.findIndex(
+    (spread) =>
+      spread.ivs.attack === ivs.attack &&
+      spread.ivs.defense === ivs.defense &&
+      spread.ivs.stamina === ivs.stamina,
+  );
+  const spread = spreads[index];
+  const best = spreads[0];
+  if (!spread || !best) return undefined;
+  return {
+    // Competition ranking: combinations equal in product, IV sum and CP share a rank.
+    rank: 1 + spreads.filter((other) => betterFirst(other, spread) < 0).length,
+    of: spreads.length,
+    percent: (spread.product / best.product) * 100,
+    spread,
+    best,
+  };
+}
````

### Task 2: The PvP rank of a Pokemon with given IVs: rank

Prototype commit: `0897639cf4b17ec7a5d96fa574f3c6e4938d9ed1`

A member command for the PvP category and DMs with the bot: the rank of a
combination of IVs in Little, Great, Ultra or Master League, its share of
the best stat product, its CP and level, the best combination, up to level
50 and, where that differs, 51; a filter for trades, raids and lucky trades;
the evolution line on request. Public in the PvP category, linked to
pvpivs.com. Megas are refused.

The pokemon option of /admin boss and /admin nickname is now shared
(src/commands/pokemon-option.ts): any Pokemon of the catalogue, typed text
acting only on a name that names one outright.

````diff
diff --git a/src/commands/pokemon-option.ts b/src/commands/pokemon-option.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..56dcdf44445be9a727461e128e7976138471f585
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/commands/pokemon-option.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+import type { SlashCommandStringOption } from 'discord.js';
+import type { AppContext } from '../app-context.js';
+import { UserError } from '../discord/errors.js';
+import type { PokemonEntry } from '../domain/pogo/game-master.js';
+import { searchTokens } from '../domain/search/text.js';
+import { plain, truncate } from '../render/text.js';
+import { CHOICE_NAME, MAX_CHOICES, showsGuessed, type Choice } from './choices.js';
+
+/**
+ * The `pokemon` option of a command that takes any Pokémon of the game data: free text with
+ * autocomplete (`pokemonChoices`), whose value is a catalogue key when a choice was picked.
+ */
+export function pokemonOption(description = 'The Pokémon', required = true) {
+  return (option: SlashCommandStringOption): SlashCommandStringOption =>
+    option
+      .setName('pokemon')
+      .setDescription(description)
+      .setRequired(required)
+      .setMaxLength(100)
+      .setAutocomplete(true);
+}
+
+/** A choice of the list for a catalogue entry. */
+export const entryChoice = (entry: PokemonEntry): Choice => ({
+  name: truncate(entry.name, CHOICE_NAME),
+  value: entry.key,
+});
+
+/**
+ * The choices for typed text: what the search finds (`ctx.pokemon.find`), best first, a guess
+ * only where the name shows the guessed word; nothing while nothing is typed. `filter` narrows
+ * the Pokémon offered.
+ */
+export function pokemonChoices(
+  ctx: AppContext,
+  typed: string,
+  filter?: (entry: PokemonEntry) => boolean,
+): Choice[] {
+  if (searchTokens(typed).length === 0) return [];
+  return ctx.pokemon
+    .find(typed, { limit: MAX_CHOICES, ...(filter ? { filter } : {}) })
+    .filter((hit) => hit.match !== 'guess' || showsGuessed(hit.entry.name, hit.guessed))
+    .map((hit) => entryChoice(hit.entry));
+}
+
+/**
+ * The Pokémon a `pokemon` option names: a choice of the list (a catalogue key), or typed text
+ * that names one outright (its name, key or a nickname no other Pokémon has:
+ * `ctx.pokemon.exact`). Anything else is refused with what the text could be; nothing is
+ * guessed.
+ */
+export function namedPokemon(ctx: AppContext, value: string): PokemonEntry {
+  const text = value.trim();
+  const entry = ctx.gameData.catalogue.byKey(text) ?? ctx.pokemon.exact(text);
+  if (entry) return entry;
+  const could = ctx.pokemon.search(text).slice(0, 3);
+  throw new UserError(
+    could.length === 0
+      ? `I do not know a Pokémon called "${plain(truncate(text, 80))}". Pick one from the list.`
+      : `"${plain(truncate(text, 80))}" is not the name of one Pokémon. Did you mean ` +
+          `${could.map((one) => plain(one.name)).join(', ')}? Pick one from the list.`,
+  );
+}
diff --git a/src/commands/util/rank.test.ts b/src/commands/util/rank.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..ab5c9c1be81f00050f460fba77da824ecaba0959
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/commands/util/rank.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,211 @@
+import { InteractionContextType, MessageFlags, type APIEmbed } from 'discord.js';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { fakeAutocomplete, fakeChatInput, sent } from '../../../test/support/fake-interactions.js';
+import {
+  catalogueFixture,
+  gameDataFixture,
+  iconsFixture,
+} from '../../../test/support/game-data.js';
+import { embedOf as shownEmbed } from '../../../test/support/gym-commands.js';
+import { createTestContext } from '../../../test/support/test-context.js';
+import { InteractionRouter } from '../../discord/router.js';
+import { PokemonCatalogue } from '../../domain/pogo/catalogue.js';
+import { rank } from './rank.js';
+
+const PVP = 'PVP CHAT AND TOURNAMENTS';
+const { ctx } = createTestContext({
+  gameData: { catalogue: catalogueFixture(), icons: iconsFixture() },
+});
+const router = new InteractionRouter(ctx, [rank], []);
+
+const IVS = { attack: 10, defense: 12, stamina: 13 };
+
+async function use(options: Record<string, string | number | boolean>, extra: object = {}) {
+  const interaction = fakeChatInput({
+    commandName: 'rank',
+    parentName: PVP,
+    options: { ...IVS, ...options },
+    ...extra,
+  });
+  await router.handle(interaction as never);
+  return interaction;
+}
+
+const embedOf = (interaction: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof use>>): APIEmbed =>
+  shownEmbed(sent(interaction.reply));
+
+describe('/rank: the command', () => {
+  it('works in servers and in a DM with the bot, for every member', () => {
+    const json = rank.data.toJSON();
+    expect(json.contexts).toEqual([InteractionContextType.Guild, InteractionContextType.BotDM]);
+    expect(json.default_member_permissions).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(json.options?.map((option) => option.name)).toEqual([
+      'pokemon',
+      'attack',
+      'defense',
+      'stamina',
+      'league',
+      'filter',
+      'evolutions',
+    ]);
+    expect(rank.throttle).toEqual({ uses: 30, perSeconds: 60 });
+    expect(json.options?.find((option) => option.name === 'filter')?.description).toBe(
+      'How you got it: a trade, raid or lucky trade sets the lowest IVs it can have',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('is refused outside the PvP category and a DM', async () => {
+    const used = await use({ pokemon: 'mewtwo' }, { parentName: 'RAIDS' });
+    expect(sent(used.reply)).toEqual({
+      content: `Use this in a DM with me or under ${PVP}.`,
+      flags: MessageFlags.Ephemeral,
+    });
+  });
+});
+
+describe('/rank: the answer', () => {
+  it('is public under the PvP category, with the rank, the best combination and a link', async () => {
+    const used = await use({ pokemon: 'mewtwo' });
+    const payload = sent(used.reply);
+    expect(payload.flags).toBeUndefined();
+    const embed = embedOf(used);
+    expect(embed.title).toBe('Mewtwo 10/12/13 · Great League');
+    expect(embed.url).toBe('https://pvpivs.com/?mon=Mewtwo&cp=1500&IVs=10_12_13');
+    expect(embed).not.toHaveProperty('description');
+    expect(embed).not.toHaveProperty('footer');
+    expect(embed.fields?.map((field) => field.name)).toEqual(['Rank']);
+    const value = embed.fields?.[0]?.value ?? '';
+    expect(value).toMatch(/^\*\*Rank \d+\*\* of 4096 · \d+\.\d\d%\n\d+ CP at level \d+(\.5)?\n/);
+    expect(value).toMatch(/\nAttack \d+\.\d\d · Defense \d+\.\d\d · HP \d+\n/);
+    expect(value).toMatch(/\nBest: \d+\/\d+\/\d+ · \d+ CP at level/);
+    expect(embed.thumbnail?.url).toMatch(/^https:\/\/cdn\.leekduck\.com\/.*pm150/);
+  });
+
+  it('is the answer in a DM too', async () => {

+
+  it('ranks the best combination first, gold', async () => {

+    expect(sent((await use({ pokemon: 'kyogre_primal' })).reply).content).toBe(

+  it('refuses with a sentence when the game data does not reach level 51', async () => {

+    expect(sent(interaction.reply)).toEqual({

+  it('acts on typed text only when it names one Pokémon', async () => {

+    const used = await use({ pokemon: 'mewtw' });

+
+  it('ranks the evolution line with the same IVs on request, in the description', async () => {

+    expect(names).toEqual(['Ralts', 'Kirlia', 'Gallade', 'Gardevoir']);

+
+  it('shows all of the line of Eevee in Master League', async () => {

+    expect((embed.description ?? '').split('\n')).toHaveLength(10);

diff --git a/src/commands/util/rank.ts b/src/commands/util/rank.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4e3a7a1cc9e6551a9d31616fd7a0d73bd48aee82
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/commands/util/rank.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,178 @@
+import {
+  InteractionContextType,
+  SlashCommandBuilder,
+  type SlashCommandIntegerOption,
+} from 'discord.js';
+import type { AppContext } from '../../app-context.js';
+import type { SimpleCommand } from '../../discord/command.js';
+import { UserError } from '../../discord/errors.js';
+import { requirePvpContext } from '../../discord/guards.js';
+import { MEMBER_READ_THROTTLE } from '../../discord/throttle.js';
+import type { Ivs } from '../../domain/pogo/cp.js';
+import { PVP_MAX_LEVEL, type PokemonEntry } from '../../domain/pogo/game-master.js';
+import { pokemonPicture } from '../../domain/pogo/pokemon-icons.js';
+import {
+  cappedRanks,
+  IV_FLOOR_NAMES,
+  IV_FLOOR_VALUE,
+  IV_FLOORS,
+  LEAGUE_CP,
+  LEAGUE_NAMES,
+  LEAGUES,
+  MAX_IV,
+  type CappedRanks,
+  type IvFloor,
+  type League,
+} from '../../domain/pvp/rank.js';
+import { ivText, renderRank } from '../../render/pvp-rank.js';
+import { plain } from '../../render/text.js';
+import { namedPokemon, pokemonChoices, pokemonOption } from '../pokemon-option.js';
+
+const isLeague = (value: string): value is League => (LEAGUES as readonly string[]).includes(value);
+const isFloor = (value: string): value is IvFloor =>
+  (IV_FLOORS as readonly string[]).includes(value);
+
+/** A mega is in no league of Go Battle League (ruling, plan 6A). */
+const ranked = (entry: PokemonEntry): boolean => entry.kind !== 'mega';
+
+function ivOption(name: keyof Ivs) {
+  return (option: SlashCommandIntegerOption): SlashCommandIntegerOption =>
+    option
+      .setName(name)
+      .setDescription(`The ${name} IV, 0 to 15`)
+      .setRequired(true)
+      .setMinValue(0)
+      .setMaxValue(MAX_IV);
+}
+
+/** The ranks of these IVs for one Pokémon in the league asked for. */
+function ranksOf(
+  ctx: AppContext,
+  entry: PokemonEntry,
+  ivs: Ivs,
+  league: League,
+  floor: IvFloor,
+): CappedRanks {
+  return cappedRanks(entry.stats, ctx.gameData.catalogue.cpMultipliers, ivs, {
+    leagueCp: LEAGUE_CP[league],
+    floor: IV_FLOOR_VALUE[floor],
+  });
+}
+
+/**
+ * `/rank` (spec 4.2, the legacy `!rank`, `!great`, `!ultra`, `!master`, `!little` and their
+ * `-evo` forms): where a Pokémon with these IVs stands among all combinations in a league of
+ * Go Battle League, up to level 50 and, where that differs, 51. Used under the PvP category or
+ * in a DM with the bot; the answer is public there, as the legacy bot's was.
+ */
+export const rank: SimpleCommand = {
+  data: new SlashCommandBuilder()
+    .setName('rank')
+    .setDescription('The PvP rank of a Pokémon with these IVs in a league')
+    .setContexts(InteractionContextType.Guild, InteractionContextType.BotDM)
+    .addStringOption(pokemonOption())
+    .addIntegerOption(ivOption('attack'))
+    .addIntegerOption(ivOption('defense'))
+    .addIntegerOption(ivOption('stamina'))
+    .addStringOption((option) =>
+      option
+        .setName('league')
+        .setDescription('The league; Great League when not given')
+        .addChoices(LEAGUES.map((league) => ({ name: LEAGUE_NAMES[league], value: league }))),
+    )
+    .addStringOption((option) =>
+      option
+        .setName('filter')
+        .setDescription(
+          'How you got it: a trade, raid or lucky trade sets the lowest IVs it can have',
+        )
+        .addChoices(
+          IV_FLOORS.map((floor) => ({
+            name:
+              floor === 'none'
+                ? IV_FLOOR_NAMES[floor]
+                : `${IV_FLOOR_NAMES[floor]} (IVs ${String(IV_FLOOR_VALUE[floor])} and up)`,
+            value: floor,
+          })),
+        ),
+    )
+    .addBooleanOption((option) =>
+      option
+        .setName('evolutions')
+        .setDescription('Also rank what it evolves into, with the same IVs'),
+    ),
+  help: {
+    category: 'util',
+    details: (settings) =>
+      'Where a Pokémon with these IVs stands among all 4,096 combinations in a league: its ' +
+      'rank by stat product, its share of the best, the CP and level it can reach, and the ' +
+      'best combination. Up to level 50, and up to 51 (a best buddy) where that differs. ' +
+      '`filter` ranks only the combinations a trade, a raid or a lucky trade can give. ' +
+      `Use it under ${settings.categories.pvp} or in a DM with me.`,
+    examples: [
+      '/rank pokemon:Medicham attack:0 defense:15 stamina:15',
+      '/rank pokemon:Mewtwo attack:10 defense:12 stamina:13 league:master filter:raid',
+      '/rank pokemon:Ralts attack:1 defense:14 stamina:15 evolutions:True',
+    ],
+  },
+  guards: [requirePvpContext],
+  throttle: MEMBER_READ_THROTTLE,
+  async execute(interaction, ctx) {
+    const entry = namedPokemon(ctx, interaction.options.getString('pokemon', true));
+    if (!ranked(entry)) {
+      const kind = entry.tempEvolution === 'PRIMAL' ? 'primal' : 'mega';
+      throw new UserError(
+        `${plain(entry.name)} is a ${kind} form, and megas and primals do not battle in Go ` +
+          'Battle League.',
+      );
+    }
+    if (ctx.gameData.catalogue.cpMultipliers.length < PVP_MAX_LEVEL) {
+      throw new UserError(
+        `The game data I have does not reach level ${String(PVP_MAX_LEVEL)}, so I cannot rank ` +
+          'IVs just now.',
+      );
+    }
+    const ivs: Ivs = {
+      attack: interaction.options.getInteger('attack', true),
+      defense: interaction.options.getInteger('defense', true),
+      stamina: interaction.options.getInteger('stamina', true),
+    };
+    if (Object.values(ivs).some((iv) => iv < 0 || iv > MAX_IV)) {
+      throw new UserError('An IV is a number from 0 to 15.');
+    }
+    const leagueValue = interaction.options.getString('league') ?? 'great';
+    const floorValue = interaction.options.getString('filter') ?? 'none';
+    if (!isLeague(leagueValue) || !isFloor(floorValue)) {
+      throw new UserError('Pick the league and the filter from their lists.');
+    }
+    const floor = IV_FLOOR_VALUE[floorValue];
+    if (Math.min(ivs.attack, ivs.defense, ivs.stamina) < floor) {
+      throw new UserError(
+        `With the filter "${IV_FLOOR_NAMES[floorValue]}" every IV is ${String(floor)} or more, ` +
+          `and ${ivText(ivs)} has one below that.`,
+      );
+    }
+    const line = interaction.options.getBoolean('evolutions')
+      ? ctx.gameData.catalogue.evolutionLine(entry).map((member) => ({
+          entry: member,
+          ranks: ranksOf(ctx, member, ivs, leagueValue, floorValue),
+        }))
+      : undefined;
+    const embed = renderRank({
+      entry,
+      ivs,
+      league: leagueValue,
+      floor: floorValue,
+      ranks: line?.[0]?.ranks ?? ranksOf(ctx, entry, ivs, leagueValue, floorValue),
+      ...(line ? { line } : {}),
+      picture: pokemonPicture(undefined, entry, ctx.gameData),
+    });
+    await interaction.reply({ embeds: [embed] });
+  },
+  async autocomplete(interaction, ctx) {
+    const focused = interaction.options.getFocused(true);
+    await interaction.respond(
+      focused.name === 'pokemon' ? pokemonChoices(ctx, String(focused.value), ranked) : [],
+    );
+  },
+};

 const PRUNE_ABOVE = 5_000;
 
 /**

+      leagueCp: 1500,
+      floor: 0,
+    });
+    expect(lowStats).not.toHaveProperty('level51');
+    // In Master League level 51 only raises the CP: 15/15/15 is the best at either cap.
+    const master = cappedRanks(stats('mewtwo'), catalogue.cpMultipliers, ivs, {
+      leagueCp: undefined,
+      floor: 0,
+    });
+    expect(master.level50?.spread.level).toBe(50);
+    expect(master).not.toHaveProperty('level51');
+    const medicham = cappedRanks(stats('medicham'), catalogue.cpMultipliers, ivs, {
+      leagueCp: 1500,
+      floor: 0,
+    });
+    expect(medicham.level51?.rank).not.toBe(medicham.level50?.rank);
+  });
+
+  it('ranks the nine of the line of Eevee in Master League in well under half a second', () => {
+    const eevee = catalogue.byKey('eevee');

diff --git a/src/domain/pvp/rank.ts b/src/domain/pvp/rank.ts
index a903b0a9fa8db6155eeb2cbbb886d8430ff454ab..fa38c646490e97e9896b743a26efc87c7925d5c0 100644
--- a/src/domain/pvp/rank.ts
+++ b/src/domain/pvp/rank.ts
@@ -210,3 +210,40 @@ export function pvpRank(
     best,
   };
 }
+
+/** The rank of one combination with each level cap. */
+export interface CappedRanks {
+  /** Up to level 50; undefined when the combination cannot be in the league. */
+  level50: PvpRank | undefined;
+  /**
+   * Up to level 51 (a best buddy), when the rank, the count or the best combination differs
+   * from level 50: a higher CP alone (always so in Master League) is no reason for a second
+   * column.
+   */
+  level51?: PvpRank | undefined;
+}
+
+/** Whether level 51 says something level 50 does not: another rank, count or best. */
+function differs(level50: PvpRank | undefined, level51: PvpRank | undefined): boolean {
+  if (!level50 || !level51) return level50 !== level51;
+  const best = (ranked: PvpRank): string => JSON.stringify(ranked.best.ivs);
+  return (
+    level50.rank !== level51.rank || level50.of !== level51.of || best(level50) !== best(level51)
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * The rank of `ivs` up to level 50 and, when that changes the standing, up to level 51.
+ * `cpMultipliers` are the game master's (`PokemonCatalogue.cpMultipliers`).
+ */
+export function cappedRanks(
+  stats: PokemonEntry['stats'],
+  cpMultipliers: readonly number[],
+  ivs: Ivs,
+  options: Omit<RankOptions, 'levelCap'>,
+): CappedRanks {
+  const multipliers = pvpMultipliers(cpMultipliers, 51);
+  const level50 = pvpRank(stats, multipliers, ivs, { ...options, levelCap: 50 });
+  const level51 = pvpRank(stats, multipliers, ivs, { ...options, levelCap: 51 });
+  return differs(level50, level51) ? { level50, level51 } : { level50 };
+}

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { catalogueFixture } from '../../test/support/game-data.js';
+import { percentText, pvpivsLink, rankColour, renderRank } from './pvp-rank.js';
+
+const catalogue = catalogueFixture();
+
+describe('pvpivsLink', () => {
+  it('names the Pokémon, the league CP and the IVs', () => {
+    const azumarill = catalogue.byKey('azumarill');
+    if (!azumarill) throw new Error('no azumarill');
+    expect(pvpivsLink(azumarill, 'ultra', { attack: 0, defense: 14, stamina: 15 })).toBe(
+      'https://pvpivs.com/?mon=Azumarill&cp=2500&IVs=0_14_15',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('encodes spaces and parentheses, so the address can stand in a masked link', () => {
+    const origin = catalogue.byKey('giratina_origin');
+    if (!origin) throw new Error('no giratina_origin');
+    const link = pvpivsLink(origin, 'little', { attack: 1, defense: 2, stamina: 3 });
+    expect(link).toBe('https://pvpivs.com/?mon=Giratina%20%28Origin%20Forme%29&cp=500&IVs=1_2_3');
+    expect(link).not.toMatch(/[()\s]/);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('rankColour', () => {
+  it('is gold, silver and bronze by the share of the best stat product', () => {
+    expect(rankColour(100)).toBe(0xffd700);
+    expect(rankColour(99)).toBe(0xffd700);
+    expect(rankColour(98.99)).toBe(0xc0c0c0);
+    expect(rankColour(97)).toBe(0xc0c0c0);
+    expect(rankColour(95)).toBe(0xcd7f32);
+    expect(rankColour(94.99)).toBe(0x30839f);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('percentText', () => {
+  it('cuts to two places, so only the best shows 100%', () => {
+    expect(percentText(100)).toBe('100.00%');
+    expect(percentText(99.999)).toBe('99.99%');
+    expect(percentText(87.5)).toBe('87.50%');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('renderRank', () => {
+  it('says of a combination too strong for the league already at level 1 that it is', () => {
+    const mewtwo = catalogue.byKey('mewtwo');
+    if (!mewtwo) throw new Error('no mewtwo');
+    const embed = renderRank({
+      entry: mewtwo,
+      ivs: { attack: 15, defense: 15, stamina: 15 },
+      league: 'little',
+      floor: 'none',
+      ranks: { level50: undefined },
+    });
+    expect(embed.title).toBe('Mewtwo 15/15/15 · Little League');
+    expect(embed.fields).toEqual([
+      { name: 'Rank', value: 'Too strong for Little League already at level 1 (above 500 CP).' },
+    ]);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/render/pvp-rank.ts b/src/render/pvp-rank.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4c190909f39bed0866042ee0db2619be2d5bf1d1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/render/pvp-rank.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,154 @@
+import type { APIEmbed } from 'discord.js';
+import type { Ivs } from '../domain/pogo/cp.js';
+import type { PokemonEntry } from '../domain/pogo/game-master.js';
+import {
+  IV_FLOOR_NAMES,
+  IV_FLOOR_VALUE,
+  LEAGUE_CP,
+  LEAGUE_NAMES,
+  type CappedRanks,
+  type IvFloor,
+  type League,
+  type PvpRank,
+  type Spread,
+} from '../domain/pvp/rank.js';
+import { fitItems, LIMITS, plain } from './text.js';
+
+/** The CP pvpivs.com takes for a league; Master League is any CP. */
+const PVPIVS_CP: Readonly<Record<League, number>> = {
+  little: 500,
+  great: 1500,
+  ultra: 2500,
+  master: 10_000,
+};
+
+/**
+ * The page of pvpivs.com with the ranking of a Pokémon in a league (spec 6.3). The site is
+ * given the Pokémon's English name; whether it reads every form's name so is for staging to
+ * show. Parentheses are encoded too, so the address can stand in a masked link.
+ */
+export function pvpivsLink(entry: PokemonEntry, league: League, ivs: Ivs): string {
+  const name = encodeURIComponent(entry.name).replace(/\(/g, '%28').replace(/\)/g, '%29');
+  return (
+    `https://pvpivs.com/?mon=${name}&cp=${String(PVPIVS_CP[league])}` +
+    `&IVs=${String(ivs.attack)}_${String(ivs.defense)}_${String(ivs.stamina)}`
+  );
+}
+
+/** The colour of the answer by the share of the best stat product: gold, silver, bronze. */
+export function rankColour(percent: number): number {
+  if (percent >= 99) return 0xffd700;
+  if (percent >= 97) return 0xc0c0c0;
+  if (percent >= 95) return 0xcd7f32;
+  return 0x30839f;
+}
+
+/** `98.53%`: cut, not rounded, so that only the best combination shows 100%. */
+export function percentText(percent: number): string {
+  return `${(Math.floor(percent * 100) / 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
+}
+
+/** `10/12/13`. */
+export const ivText = (ivs: Ivs): string =>
+  `${String(ivs.attack)}/${String(ivs.defense)}/${String(ivs.stamina)}`;
+
+/** `1499 CP at level 22.5`. */
+const atLevel = (spread: Spread): string =>
+  `${String(spread.cp)} CP at level ${String(spread.level)}`;
+
+/** What one level cap gives a combination, in lines. */
+function rankLines(ranked: PvpRank | undefined, league: League): string {
+  if (!ranked) return notInLeague(league);
+  const { spread, best } = ranked;
+  return [
+    `**Rank ${String(ranked.rank)}** of ${String(ranked.of)} · ${percentText(ranked.percent)}`,
+    atLevel(spread),
+    `Attack ${spread.attack.toFixed(2)} · Defense ${spread.defense.toFixed(2)} · HP ${String(spread.hp)}`,
+    `Best: ${ivText(best.ivs)} · ${atLevel(best)}`,
+  ].join('\n');
+}
+
+function notInLeague(league: League): string {
+  return `Too strong for ${LEAGUE_NAMES[league]} already at level 1 (above ${String(LEAGUE_CP[league])} CP).`;
+}
+
+/** A member of the evolution line, ranked with the same IVs. */
+export interface LineMember {
+  entry: PokemonEntry;
+  ranks: CappedRanks;
+}
+
+/** What `/rank` shows. */
+export interface RankView {
+  entry: PokemonEntry;
+  ivs: Ivs;
+  league: League;
+  floor: IvFloor;
+  ranks: CappedRanks;
+  /** The evolution line, when it was asked for: the Pokémon itself first. */
+  line?: readonly LineMember[];
+  /** Address of the Pokémon's picture. */
+  picture?: string | undefined;
+}
+
+/** One member of the evolution line on one line (the title links to pvpivs.com). */
+function lineText(member: LineMember, view: RankView): string {
+  const name = `**${plain(member.entry.name)}**`;
+  const { level50, level51 } = member.ranks;
+  if (!level50) return `${name} · ${notInLeague(view.league)}`;
+  const buddy =
+    level51 && level51.rank !== level50.rank ? ` (best buddy: rank ${String(level51.rank)})` : '';
+  return (
+    `${name} · rank ${String(level50.rank)}${buddy} · ${percentText(level50.percent)} · ` +
+    atLevel(level50.spread)
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * The answer of `/rank`: the legacy layout made tidy. The title names the Pokémon, the IVs and
+ * the league and links to the ranking on pvpivs.com; the fields say where the combination stands
+ * up to level 50, and up to level 51 (a best buddy) when that differs, with the best
+ * combination; the evolution line on request is the description (it holds 4,096 characters, a
+ * field 1,024); a filter is the footer. Coloured by the share of the best stat product.
+ */
+export function renderRank(view: RankView): APIEmbed {
+  const { entry, ivs, league, floor, ranks } = view;
+  const fields: NonNullable<APIEmbed['fields']> =
+    ranks.level51 === undefined
+      ? [{ name: 'Rank', value: rankLines(ranks.level50, league) }]
+      : [
+          { name: 'Up to level 50', value: rankLines(ranks.level50, league), inline: true },
+          {
+            name: 'Up to level 51 (best buddy)',
+            value: rankLines(ranks.level51, league),
+            inline: true,
+          },
+        ];
+  const heading = '**Evolution line**\n';
+  const description =
+    view.line === undefined
+      ? undefined
+      : heading +
+        (view.line.length <= 1
+          ? `${plain(entry.name)} does not evolve.`
+          : fitItems(
+              view.line.map((member) => lineText(member, view)),
+              LIMITS.embedDescription - heading.length,
+              '\n',
+            ));
+  return {
+    title: `${entry.name} ${ivText(ivs)} · ${LEAGUE_NAMES[league]}`,
+    url: pvpivsLink(entry, league, ivs),
+    ...(description === undefined ? {} : { description }),
+    color: rankColour(ranks.level50?.percent ?? 0),
+    fields,
+    ...(view.picture === undefined ? {} : { thumbnail: { url: view.picture } }),
+    ...(floor === 'none'
+      ? {}
+      : {
+          footer: {
+            text: `Filter: ${IV_FLOOR_NAMES[floor]} (IVs from ${String(IV_FLOOR_VALUE[floor])})`,
+          },
+        }),
+  };
+}
````

### Task 3: Whether a Pokemon is a raid boss now, and the map of the regions

Prototype commit: `686429ab6225a427c0d0b13cea34897f4bca259c`

boss-tier says privately which tiers a Pokemon is a boss of now (from the
boss list members see, shiny marked, other forms of its species that are
bosses beside it), or without a Pokemon the whole list by tier.

maps gives the address of the map of all regions privately, in servers and

````diff
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f802e3f8cb66c8c2dfb439ab037d724ed0a8a03a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/commands/util/boss-tier.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,184 @@
+import { MessageFlags, SlashCommandBuilder } from 'discord.js';
+import type { AppContext } from '../../app-context.js';
+import type { SimpleCommand } from '../../discord/command.js';
+import { answer } from '../../discord/late-reply.js';
+import { MEMBER_READ_THROTTLE } from '../../discord/throttle.js';
+import type { PokemonEntry } from '../../domain/pogo/game-master.js';
+import { autosetBoss, type RaidBoss } from '../../domain/pogo/raid-bosses.js';
+import { raidTierLabel, sameRaidTier, type RaidTier } from '../../domain/pogo/raid-tier.js';
+import { fitMessages, plain, truncate } from '../../render/text.js';
+import { CHOICE_NAME, MAX_CHOICES, type Choice } from '../choices.js';
+import { entryChoice, namedPokemon, pokemonChoices, pokemonOption } from '../pokemon-option.js';
+
+/** The mark of a boss that can be shiny, and what it means. */
+const SHINY = '✨';
+const SHINY_LEGEND = `${SHINY} can be shiny.`;
+
+/** `T5`, `T5 ✨`. */
+const tierText = (boss: RaidBoss): string =>
+  `${raidTierLabel(boss.tier)}${boss.shiny ? ` ${SHINY}` : ''}`;
+
+/** `A, B and C`. */
+function andList(items: readonly string[]): string {
+  if (items.length <= 1) return items.join('');
+  return `${items.slice(0, -1).join(', ')} and ${items.at(-1) ?? ''}`;
+}
+
+/** Lower case, spaces made single: how names are compared. */
+const comparable = (text: string): string => text.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toLowerCase();
+
+/** The words of a name, between single spaces: `Yveltal (Festival)` → ` yveltal festival `. */
+const wordsOf = (name: string): string =>
+  ` ${name
+    .toLowerCase()
+    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, ' ')
+    .trim()} `;
+
+/**
+ * The words of the name of a species without what tells its forms apart: `Landorus (Incarnate
+ * Forme)` → ` landorus `.
+ */
+const speciesWords = (name: string): string => wordsOf(name.replace(/\s*\(.*\)\s*$/, ''));
+
+/**
+ * The sentence about one Pokémon (`name`, already made plain) and the bosses that are it, then
+ * the line of others that are bosses beside it, with the legend of the shiny mark when a mark
+ * was shown.
+ */
+function bossSentence(name: string, own: readonly RaidBoss[], kin: readonly RaidBoss[]): string {
+  const lines = [
+    own.length === 0
+      ? `**${name}** is not a raid boss now.`
+      : `**${name}** is a boss of ${andList(own.map(tierText))} raids now.`,
+  ];
+  if (kin.length > 0) {
+    lines.push(
+      `Also a boss now: ${andList(kin.map((boss) => `${plain(boss.name)} (${tierText(boss)})`))}.`,
+    );
+  }
+  const text = lines.join('\n');
+  return [...own, ...kin].some((boss) => boss.shiny) ? `${text} ${SHINY_LEGEND}` : text;
+}
+
+/**
+ * What `/boss-tier pokemon` says: every tier the Pokémon is a boss of now, from the boss list
+ * members see (the feed with the moderators' overrides), and the other bosses of its species:
+ * its other entries (a mega beside the plain Pokémon), and bosses the game data does not know
+ * yet whose name has the species' name (a costume newer than the game data). `speciesName` is
+ * the name of the species' own entry.
+ */
+export function bossTierText(
+  bosses: readonly RaidBoss[],
+  entry: PokemonEntry,
+  speciesName: string = entry.name,
+): string {
+  const own = bosses.filter((boss) => boss.entry?.key === entry.key);
+  const species = speciesWords(speciesName);
+  const kin = bosses.filter((boss) =>
+    boss.entry === undefined
+      ? species.trim() !== '' && wordsOf(boss.name).includes(species)
+      : boss.entry.key !== entry.key && boss.entry.dex === entry.dex,
+  );
+  return bossSentence(plain(entry.name), own, kin);
+}
+
+/**
+ * The bosses the game data does not know yet whose name is the typed text (without regard to
+ * case); empty for any other text.
+ */
+function unknownBossesNamed(bosses: readonly RaidBoss[], typed: string): RaidBoss[] {
+  const text = comparable(typed);
+  return bosses.filter((boss) => boss.entry === undefined && comparable(boss.name) === text);
+}
+
+/**
+ * The boss list as members see it, tier by tier: each tier's bosses, those that can be shiny
+ * marked, and what eggs of a tier with several bosses hatch as when the moderators said so. No
+ * staff details.
+ */
+export function bossListText(bosses: readonly RaidBoss[]): string[] {
+  if (bosses.length === 0) return ['There are no raid bosses now.'];
+  const lines = ['**Raid bosses now**'];
+  const tiers: RaidTier[] = [];
+  for (const boss of bosses) {
+    if (!tiers.some((tier) => sameRaidTier(tier, boss.tier))) tiers.push(boss.tier);
+  }
+  for (const tier of tiers) {
+    const ofTier = bosses.filter((boss) => sameRaidTier(boss.tier, tier));
+    const names = ofTier.map((boss) => `${plain(boss.name)}${boss.shiny ? ` ${SHINY}` : ''}`);
+    // A tier of one boss hatches as it: saying so would only repeat the name.
+    const hatches = ofTier.length > 1 ? autosetBoss(bosses, tier) : undefined;
+    lines.push(
+      `**${raidTierLabel(tier)}**: ${names.join(', ')}` +
+        (hatches ? ` · eggs hatch as ${plain(hatches.name)}` : ''),
+    );
+  }
+  if (bosses.some((boss) => boss.shiny)) lines.push(SHINY_LEGEND);
+  return lines;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The choices of the `pokemon` option: the bosses while nothing is typed (one the game data
+ * does not know yet by its name, which `execute` reads), else any Pokémon.
+ */
+function bossTierChoices(ctx: AppContext, typed: string): Choice[] {
+  if (typed.trim() !== '') return pokemonChoices(ctx, typed);
+  const choices = new Map<string, Choice>();
+  for (const boss of ctx.raidBosses.bosses()) {
+    if (boss.entry) choices.set(boss.entry.key, entryChoice(boss.entry));
+    else if (boss.name.length <= 100) {
+      choices.set(boss.name, { name: truncate(boss.name, CHOICE_NAME), value: boss.name });
+    }
+  }
+  return [...choices.values()].slice(0, MAX_CHOICES);
+}
+
+/**
+ * `/boss-tier` (the legacy `!boss-tier`, `!boss-level`): whether a Pokémon is a raid boss now
+ * and of which tiers, from `ctx.raidBosses`; without a Pokémon, the whole boss list by tier.
+ * For the member alone.
+ */
+export const bossTier: SimpleCommand = {
+  data: new SlashCommandBuilder()
+    .setName('boss-tier')
+    .setDescription('Whether a Pokémon is a raid boss now, and of which tier; or all bosses')
+    .addStringOption(pokemonOption('The Pokémon; without one, every raid boss now', false)),
+  help: {
+    category: 'util',
+    details:
+      'With a Pokémon: whether it is a raid boss now, of which tiers, and whether it can be ' +
+      'shiny. Without one: every raid boss now, tier by tier. Only you see the answer.',
+    examples: ['/boss-tier pokemon:Mewtwo', '/boss-tier'],
+  },
+  defer: 'late',
+  throttle: MEMBER_READ_THROTTLE,
+  async execute(interaction, ctx) {
+    const typed = interaction.options.getString('pokemon');
+    const bosses = ctx.raidBosses.bosses();
+    if (typed !== null) {
+      // A boss the game data does not know yet is named by the feed's name only, and is what
+      // the text means only when the text names no Pokémon outright.
+      const own = ctx.pokemon.exact(typed) ? [] : unknownBossesNamed(bosses, typed);
+      const [unknown] = own;
+      if (unknown) {
+        await answer(interaction, { content: bossSentence(plain(unknown.name), own, []) });
+        return;
+      }
+      const entry = namedPokemon(ctx, typed);
+      const species = ctx.gameData.catalogue.species(entry.dex)?.name ?? entry.name;
+      await answer(interaction, { content: bossTierText(bosses, entry, species) });
+      return;
+    }
+    const [first = '', ...rest] = fitMessages(bossListText(bosses));
+    await answer(interaction, { content: first });
+    for (const more of rest) {
+      await interaction.followUp({ content: more, flags: MessageFlags.Ephemeral });
+    }
+  },
+  async autocomplete(interaction, ctx) {
+    const focused = interaction.options.getFocused(true);
+    await interaction.respond(
+      focused.name === 'pokemon' ? bossTierChoices(ctx, String(focused.value)) : [],
+    );
+  },
+};

+import { InteractionContextType, MessageFlags, SlashCommandBuilder } from 'discord.js';
+import type { SimpleCommand } from '../../discord/command.js';
+import { MEMBER_READ_THROTTLE } from '../../discord/throttle.js';
+
+/**
+ * `/maps` (the legacy `!maps`): the address of the map of all regions
+ * (`settings.regionMapLink`), for the member alone; offered only where it is set. Anywhere, a
+ * DM with the bot and the post of a party too: the legacy bot sent it by DM to keep raid
+ * channels quiet, and a private answer is as quiet.
+ */
+export const maps: SimpleCommand = {
+  data: new SlashCommandBuilder()
+    .setName('maps')
+    .setDescription('The map of all regions')
+    .setContexts(InteractionContextType.Guild, InteractionContextType.BotDM),
+  help: {
+    category: 'util',
+    details: 'Gives you the address of a map that shows every region. Only you see the answer.',
+    examples: ['/maps'],
+  },
+  enabled: (config) => config.settings.regionMapLink !== undefined,
+  throttle: MEMBER_READ_THROTTLE,
+  async execute(interaction, ctx) {
+    const link = ctx.config.settings.regionMapLink;
+    await interaction.reply({
+      content:
+        link === undefined ? 'There is no map of the regions.' : `The map of all regions: ${link}`,
+      flags: MessageFlags.Ephemeral,
+    });
+  },
+};
````

### Task 4: A gym look-up for members: find-gym

Prototype commit: `cd3b90a6845b76e9c30e1a7e914cbaf1ff304ee7`

Any member of a server looks up one of its gyms, by the list, a clear
text or its number: name and nickname with a link to the place, the
description, the notice, an elite raid gym, the regions of the server it
lies in, the raids there now with links to their posts, and the map; for
the member alone. Nothing of what only staff need. A gym that cannot be
shown (none, several, another server's) is refused before the answer is
deferred and before the use counts.

The summary's line of a raid is shared (raidLine), and the title of a gym
view (gymTitle). The legacy find-gym maps to the new command in the export
of the role authorization.

```
 7 files changed, 391 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)
```

````diff
+import { MessageFlags } from 'discord.js';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  fakeAutocomplete,
+  fakeChatInput,
+  sent,
+  type FakeInteraction,
+} from '../../../test/support/fake-interactions.js';
+import { embedOf } from '../../../test/support/gym-commands.js';
+import { EAST_CHANNEL, WEST_CHANNEL, WEST_FORUM } from '../../../test/support/gyms.js';
+import { ALICE } from '../../../test/support/parties.js';
+import { reportedRaid } from '../../../test/support/party-service.js';
+import { createTestContext } from '../../../test/support/test-context.js';
+import { InteractionRouter } from '../../discord/router.js';
+import { findGym } from './find-gym.js';
+
+const SERVER = { [WEST_CHANNEL]: 'west', [EAST_CHANNEL]: 'east', '600000000000000001': 'general' };
+
+function setup(overrides: Parameters<typeof createTestContext>[0] = {}) {
+  const { ctx } = createTestContext(overrides);
+  const router = new InteractionRouter(ctx, [findGym], []);
+  const run = async (gym: string, extra: object = {}) => {
+    const interaction = fakeChatInput({
+      commandName: 'find-gym',
+      userId: ALICE,
+      guildChannelNames: SERVER,
+      options: { gym },
+      ...extra,
+    });
+    await router.handle(interaction as never);
+    return interaction;
+  };
+  const choices = async (focused: string, extra: object = {}) => {
+    const interaction = fakeAutocomplete({
+      commandName: 'find-gym',
+      userId: ALICE,
+      guildChannelNames: SERVER,
+      focusedName: 'gym',
+      focused,
+      ...extra,
+    });
+    await router.handle(interaction as never);
+    return (interaction.respond.mock.calls[0]?.[0] ?? []).map((choice) => choice.value);
+  };
+  return { ctx, run, choices };
+}
+
+const shown = (used: FakeInteraction) => embedOf(sent(used.editReply));
+const refusal = (used: FakeInteraction) => sent(used.reply).content;
+
+describe('/find-gym', () => {
+  it('is a member command of servers, private, with a gym option of its own', () => {
+    const json = findGym.data.toJSON();
+    expect(json.default_member_permissions).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(json.contexts).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(json.options?.[0]).toMatchObject({ name: 'gym', required: true, autocomplete: true });
+    expect(findGym.defer).toBe('ephemeral');
+    expect(findGym.throttle).toEqual({ uses: 10, perSeconds: 60 });
+    expect(findGym.help.category).toBe('util');
+  });
+
+  it('shows a member what they need of a gym, and nothing only staff need', async () => {
+    const made = setup({
+      maps: {
+        enabled: true,
+        gym: (asked) => Promise.resolve(`var/images/gyms/${String(asked.id)}-abc.png`),
+        region: () => Promise.resolve(undefined),
+        clear: () => Promise.resolve(0),
+      },
+    });
+    const used = await made.run('g:1', { channelId: WEST_CHANNEL });
+    expect(used.deferReply).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ flags: MessageFlags.Ephemeral });
+    expect(shown(used)).toEqual({
+      title: 'Pinewood Public Library (The Stacks)',
+      url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=40.05%2C-80.05',
+      description: 'Mural of readers beside the front doors',
+      color: 0x3498db,
+      fields: [{ name: 'Regions', value: `<#${WEST_CHANNEL}>`, inline: true }],
+      image: { url: 'attachment://1-abc.png' },
+      footer: { text: 'Gym #1' },
+    });
+    expect(sent(used.editReply).files).toEqual(['var/images/gyms/1-abc.png']);
+  });
+
+  it('shows the notice, and an elite raid gym as one', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    const gym = made.ctx.gyms.get(11);
+    if (!gym) throw new Error('no gym 11');
+    Object.assign(gym, { taggedEx: true });
+    const embed = shown(await made.run('#11'));
+    expect(embed.fields).toEqual([
+      { name: 'Notice', value: 'Park closes at dusk' },
+      { name: 'Elite raid gym', value: 'Yes', inline: true },
+      { name: 'Regions', value: `<#${WEST_CHANNEL}>`, inline: true },
+    ]);
+    expect(embed).not.toHaveProperty('image');
+  });
+
+  it('lists the raids at the gym now, with links to their posts', async () => {
+    const raid = await reportedRaid();
+    const made = setup({ parties: raid.store, regions: raid.regions });
+    const embed = shown(await made.run('g:1'));
+    const raids = embed.fields?.find((field) => field.name === 'Raids now');
+    expect(raids?.value).toMatch(new RegExp(`^<#${raid.postId}> · `));
+    expect(shown(await made.run('g:2')).fields?.map((field) => field.name)).toEqual(['Regions']);
+  });
+
+  it('acts on text only one gym of the server has every word of', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    expect(shown(await made.run('stone fountain')).title).toBe('Old Stone Fountain');
+  });
+
+  it('names the gyms that fit unclear text, with their numbers, instead of guessing', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    expect(refusal(await made.run('starbucks'))).toBe(
+      'Several gyms fit "starbucks": **Starbucks** (#5), **Starbucks** (#9). Pick one from the ' +
+        'list, or give its number (`#123`).',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('shows no gym of another server, nor one in no region', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    expect(refusal(await made.run('#10'))).toBe('This server has no gym #10.');
+    expect(refusal(await made.run('g:10'))).toBe(
+      'I found no gym of this server for "g:10". Type part of its name and pick it from the list.',
+    );
+    expect(refusal(await made.run('g:1', { guildId: '499999999999999999' }))).toMatch(
+      /^I found no gym of this server/,
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('is refused in a DM', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    expect(refusal(await made.run('g:1', { isDm: true, guildId: null }))).toBe(
+      'This only works in a server.',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('offers the gyms of the region first, and those of this server only', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    expect((await made.choices('', { channelId: WEST_CHANNEL })).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+    const offered = await made.choices('starbucks', { channelId: EAST_CHANNEL });
+    expect(offered[0]).toBe('g:9');
+    expect(offered).not.toContain('g:10');
+    expect(await made.choices('lakeview')).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('works in the post of a raid, for the region of its forum', async () => {
+    const raid = await reportedRaid();
+    const made = setup({ parties: raid.store, regions: raid.regions });
+    const used = await made.run('g:2', {
+      channelId: raid.postId,
+      thread: { parentId: WEST_FORUM },
+    });
+    expect(shown(used).title).toBe('Old Stone Fountain');
+  });
+});

+import { basename } from 'node:path';
+import { SlashCommandBuilder } from 'discord.js';
+import type { AppContext } from '../../app-context.js';
+import type { Gym } from '../../db/repositories/gym-repository.js';
+import type { Guard, LocatedInteraction, SimpleCommand } from '../../discord/command.js';
+import { UserError } from '../../discord/errors.js';
+import { regionChannelOf, requireGuild } from '../../discord/guards.js';
+import type { Throttle } from '../../discord/throttle.js';
+import { isRaid } from '../../domain/party/party.js';
+import { raidTierLabel } from '../../domain/pogo/raid-tier.js';
+import { gymWithId, renderMemberGymView } from '../../render/gym-view.js';
+import { raidLine } from '../../render/summary.js';
+import { plain, truncate } from '../../render/text.js';
+import { gymRegionsInGuild } from '../../services/region-directory.js';
+import { gymChoices, reportedGym } from '../raids/raid-input.js';
+
+/** A map picture comes with every answer, as with `/bounds`, but a look-up is asked for more often. */
+export const FIND_GYM_THROTTLE: Throttle = { uses: 10, perSeconds: 60 };
+
+/** `#123`: a gym by its number, as the view shows it. */
+const BY_NUMBER = /^#(\d{1,10})$/;
+
+/** The row id of the server an interaction came from; undefined for one the bot has no row of. */
+async function serverOf(interaction: LocatedInteraction, ctx: AppContext) {
+  return interaction.guildId === null ? undefined : ctx.guilds.idFor(interaction.guildId);
+}
+
+/** Whether a gym lies in a region of the server: no other server's gym is shown. */
+function inServer(ctx: AppContext, guildRow: number | undefined): (gym: Gym) => boolean {
+  return (gym) =>
+    guildRow !== undefined && gymRegionsInGuild(ctx.gyms, ctx.regions, gym.id, guildRow).length > 0;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The gym the `gym` option names: a choice of the list, `#<number>`, or text that only one gym
+ * of this server has every word of. Several that fit are named, for the member to pick one.
+ */
+function foundGym(
+  ctx: AppContext,
+  interaction: LocatedInteraction,
+  typed: string,
+  accepts: (gym: Gym) => boolean,
+): Gym {
+  const text = typed.trim();
+  const number = BY_NUMBER.exec(text)?.[1];
+  if (number !== undefined) {
+    const gym = ctx.gyms.get(Number(number));
+    if (gym && accepts(gym)) return gym;
+    throw new UserError(`This server has no gym #${number}.`);
+  }
+  const found = reportedGym(ctx, regionChannelOf(interaction, ctx), text, accepts);
+  if (found.kind === 'gym') return found.gym;
+  if (found.kind === 'none') {
+    throw new UserError(
+      `I found no gym of this server for "${plain(truncate(text, 80))}". Type part of its ` +
+        'name and pick it from the list.',
+    );
+  }
+  throw new UserError(
+    `Several gyms fit "${plain(truncate(text, 80))}": ` +
+      `${found.gyms.map((gym) => gymWithId(gym)).join(', ')}. Pick one from the list, or give ` +
+      'its number (`#123`).',
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * A gym that cannot be shown is refused before the answer is deferred and before the use counts
+ * against the limit.
+ */
+const requireFoundGym: Guard = async (interaction, ctx) => {
+  if (!interaction.isChatInputCommand()) return;
+  foundGym(
+    ctx,
+    interaction,
+    interaction.options.getString('gym', true),
+    inServer(ctx, await serverOf(interaction, ctx)),
+  );
+};
+
+/**
+ * `/find-gym` (the legacy `!find-gym`, `!fort`; decided in plan 6A): a member's look-up of a
+ * gym of this server: what a member needs of it, the regions it lies in, the raids there now and
+ * the map, for the member alone. `/gym show` is the staff's view.
+ */
+export const findGym: SimpleCommand = {
+  data: new SlashCommandBuilder()
+    .setName('find-gym')
+    .setDescription('Look up a gym: where it is, its regions and its raids now')
+    .addStringOption((option) =>
+      option
+        .setName('gym')
+        .setDescription('The gym: type part of its name and pick from the list')
+        .setRequired(true)
+        .setMaxLength(100)
+        .setAutocomplete(true),
+    ),
+  help: {
+    category: 'util',
+    details:
+      'Shows a gym of this server: its name and nickname with a link to the place, its ' +
+      'description and notice, whether it is an elite raid gym, the regions it lies in, the ' +
+      'raids there now and a map. Pick the gym from the list that appears while you type ' +
+      '(the gyms of the region you are in come first), or give its number (`#123`). Only you ' +
+      'see the answer.',
+    examples: ['/find-gym gym:Big Fountain', '/find-gym gym:#123'],
+  },
+  guards: [requireGuild, requireFoundGym],
+  defer: 'ephemeral',
+  throttle: FIND_GYM_THROTTLE,
+  async execute(interaction, ctx) {
+    const guildRow = await serverOf(interaction, ctx);
+    const gym = foundGym(
+      ctx,
+      interaction,
+      interaction.options.getString('gym', true),
+      inServer(ctx, guildRow),
+    );
+    const now = Date.now();
+    const raids = ctx.parties
+      .active()
+      .filter(isRaid)
+      .filter((party) => party.gymId === gym.id && party.guildId === guildRow)
+      .map((party) => raidLine({ party, title: `${raidTierLabel(party.raid.tier)} raid` }, now));
+    const map = await ctx.maps.gym(gym).catch((err: unknown) => {
+      ctx.log.warn({ err, gym: gym.id }, 'could not get the map of a gym');
+      return undefined;
+    });
+    const embed = renderMemberGymView({
+      gym,
+      regions:
+        guildRow === undefined ? [] : gymRegionsInGuild(ctx.gyms, ctx.regions, gym.id, guildRow),
+      raids,
+      image: map === undefined ? undefined : `attachment://${basename(map)}`,
+    });
+    await interaction.editReply({ embeds: [embed], files: map === undefined ? [] : [map] });
+  },
+  async autocomplete(interaction, ctx) {
+    const regionName = (channelId: string): string | undefined =>
+      interaction.guild?.channels.cache.get(channelId)?.name;
+    await interaction.respond(
+      gymChoices(
+        ctx,
+        regionChannelOf(interaction, ctx),
+        interaction.options.getFocused(),
+        regionName,
+        inServer(ctx, await serverOf(interaction, ctx)),
+      ),
+    );
+  },
+};

@@ -206,3 +213,55 @@ export function renderGymView(view: GymView): APIEmbed {

 }
+
+/** What a member's view of a gym shows (`/find-gym`). */
+export interface MemberGymView {
+  gym: Omit<ViewedGym, 'keywords' | 'geodata' | 'places'>;
+  /** The regions of the server the view is shown in that the gym lies in. */
+  regions: readonly { channelId: string }[];
+  /** The active raids at the gym in this server, as lines (`raidAtGymLine`). */
+  raids: readonly string[];
+  /** The address of the map picture (an attachment of the message); undefined without one. */
+  image?: string | undefined;
+}
+
+/**
+ * A gym as a member looks it up (`/find-gym`): name and nickname as a link to the place, the
+ * description, the notice, whether it is an elite raid gym, the regions of this server it lies
+ * in, the raids there now and the map. Nothing of what only staff need (keywords, what Google
+ * gave, the nearest gym, gym targets, the coordinates); the number only in the footer. Every
+ * text is plain and cut as in `renderGymView`.
+ */
+export function renderMemberGymView(view: MemberGymView): APIEmbed {
+  const { gym } = view;
+  const fields: APIEmbedField[] = [];
+  if (gym.notice) {
+    const notice = plainLines(gym.notice);
+    if (notice !== '') fields.push({ name: 'Notice', value: truncate(notice, LIMITS.fieldValue) });
+  }
+  if (isEliteGym(gym)) fields.push({ name: 'Elite raid gym', value: 'Yes', inline: true });
+  fields.push({
+    name: 'Regions',
+    value:
+      view.regions.length === 0
+        ? 'None of this server'
+        : fitItems(
+            view.regions.map((region) => `<#${region.channelId}>`),
+            SHOWN.regions,
+          ),
+    inline: true,
+  });
+  if (view.raids.length > 0) {
+    fields.push({ name: 'Raids now', value: fitItems(view.raids, SHOWN.raids, '\n') });
+  }
+  const description = gym.description ? plainLines(gym.description) : '';
+  return {
+    title: truncate(gymTitle(gym), LIMITS.embedTitle),
+    url: gymMapsUrl(gym),
+    ...(description === '' ? {} : { description: truncate(description, SHOWN.description) }),
+    color: GYM_COLOUR,
+    fields,
+    ...(view.image === undefined ? {} : { image: { url: view.image } }),
+    footer: { text: `Gym #${gym.id}` },
+  };
+}
````

---

### Task 5: Gym requests from members as GitHub issues: request

Prototype commit: `cfbee362970631543291ccbdbdf7f864d85f26fb`

A member asks for a change to a gym, of the raid or train whose post it is
used in or named with the gym option; it is opened as an issue in
GITHUB_REPO with GITHUB_TOKEN ("Gym request: <name> (#<id>)", who asked
from which server and the text, labelled with the gym's number; an @ pings
nobody on GitHub). The command exists only where both are set, allows three
requests in half an hour, and refuses what it can before anything is sent
or counted. The member is told privately whether it went.

GitHubIssues (src/services/issue-gateway.ts) is the port: fetch with a
time limit, the token only in the header, never logged; every failure is
an answer. FakeIssues is its twin for tests; ctx.issues holds it.

The gym option of find-gym and request is shared (server-gym.ts).
