diff --git a/src/commands/util/request.test.ts b/src/commands/util/request.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..09a546210df27a69cc87ef6d9b94fb856783da97
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/commands/util/request.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,215 @@
+import { MessageFlags } from 'discord.js';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  fakeAutocomplete,
+  fakeChatInput,
+  sent,
+  type FakeInteraction,
+} from '../../../test/support/fake-interactions.js';
+import { EAST_CHANNEL, WEST_CHANNEL, WEST_FORUM } from '../../../test/support/gyms.js';
+import { FakeIssues } from '../../../test/support/issues.js';
+import { ALICE, REPORTER } from '../../../test/support/parties.js';
+import { createdMeetup, createdTrain, reportedRaid } from '../../../test/support/party-service.js';
+import { createTestContext } from '../../../test/support/test-context.js';
+import { InteractionRouter } from '../../discord/router.js';
+import { request } from './request.js';
+
+const SERVER = { [WEST_CHANNEL]: 'west', [EAST_CHANNEL]: 'east' };
+
+function setup(overrides: Parameters<typeof createTestContext>[0] = {}) {
+  const issues = new FakeIssues();
+  const { ctx, entries } = createTestContext({ issues, ...overrides });
+  const router = new InteractionRouter(ctx, [request], []);
+  const run = async (options: Record<string, string>, extra: object = {}) => {
+    const interaction = fakeChatInput({
+      commandName: 'request',
+      userId: ALICE,
+      displayName: 'Alice',
+      guildName: 'Pinewood Raids',
+      guildChannelNames: SERVER,
+      options,
+      ...extra,
+    });
+    await router.handle(interaction as never);
+    return interaction;
+  };
+  return { ctx, entries, issues, router, run };
+}
+
+/** What the member was told: the answer after the deferral, or a refusal before it. */
+function told(used: FakeInteraction): string | undefined {
+  for (const mock of [used.editReply, used.followUp, used.reply]) {
+    if (mock.mock.calls.length > 0) return sent(mock).content;
+  }
+  throw new Error('nothing was answered');
+}
+
+describe('/request: the command', () => {
+  it('exists only where GitHub is set up, for members of servers, three in half an hour', () => {
+    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
+    expect(request.enabled?.(ctx.config)).toBe(false);
+    const env = { ...ctx.config.env, GITHUB_TOKEN: 'token', GITHUB_REPO: 'owner/repo' };
+    expect(request.enabled?.({ ...ctx.config, env })).toBe(true);
+    const json = request.data.toJSON();
+    expect(json.default_member_permissions).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(json.contexts).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(json.options?.map((option) => [option.name, option.required])).toEqual([
+      ['text', true],
+      ['gym', false],
+    ]);
+    expect(request.throttle).toEqual({ uses: 3, perSeconds: 1800 });
+    expect(request.defer).toBe('ephemeral');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('/request: an issue', () => {
+  it('is opened for the gym named, with who asked from where, and the member is thanked', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    const used = await made.run({ text: 'The gym is now the Town Hall Fountain', gym: 'g:2' });
+    expect(used.deferReply).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ flags: MessageFlags.Ephemeral });
+    expect(made.issues.opened).toEqual([
+      {
+        title: 'Gym request: Old Stone Fountain (#2)',
+        body: 'Request from `Alice` in `Pinewood Raids`:\n\nThe gym is now the Town Hall Fountain',
+        labels: ['2'],
+      },
+    ]);
+    expect(told(used)).toBe(
+      'Thank you: your request about **Old Stone Fountain** (#2) was sent to the people who ' +
+        'keep the gym list.',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('is about the gym of the raid whose post it is made in', async () => {
+    const raid = await reportedRaid();
+    const made = setup({ parties: raid.store, regions: raid.regions });
+    await made.run(
+      { text: 'Wrong name' },
+      { channelId: raid.postId, thread: { parentId: WEST_FORUM } },
+    );
+    expect(made.issues.opened[0]?.title).toBe('Gym request: Pinewood Public Library (#1)');
+  });
+
+  it('is about the stop of the train whose post it is made in, and none once it finished', async () => {
+    const train = await createdTrain({ route: [2, 3] });
+    const made = setup({ parties: train.store, regions: train.regions });
+    const inPost = { channelId: train.postId, thread: { parentId: WEST_FORUM } };
+    await made.run({ text: 'Wrong name' }, inPost);
+    expect(made.issues.opened[0]?.title).toBe('Gym request: Old Stone Fountain (#2)');
+    await train.trains.move(train.party.id, { id: REPORTER }, 'finish', false);
+    expect(told(await made.run({ text: 'Wrong name' }, inPost))).toBe(
+      'This train is at no gym right now. Say which gym with the `gym` option.',
+    );
+    expect(made.issues.opened).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+
+  it('pings nobody on GitHub, links no issue, and keeps the text as typed', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    await made.run(
+      { text: '@everyone look: **gone** since @pine-team moved it, see #12', gym: 'g:2' },
+      { displayName: '@Alice `x`', guildName: 'Pinewood `Raids`' },
+    );
+    expect(made.issues.opened[0]?.body).toBe(
+      'Request from `@\u200bAlice x` in `Pinewood Raids`:\n\n' +
+        '@\u200beveryone look: **gone** since @\u200bpine-team moved it, see #\u200b12',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('says so when GitHub did not take it', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    made.issues.failing = { ok: false, reason: 'refused', status: 401 };
+    expect(told(await made.run({ text: 'Gone', gym: 'g:2' }))).toBe(
+      'Your request could not be sent: GitHub refused it. Please tell a moderator, who can ' +
+        'look into the log of the bot.',
+    );
+    made.issues.failing = { ok: false, reason: 'unreachable' };
+    expect(told(await made.run({ text: 'Gone', gym: 'g:2' }))).toBe(
+      'Your request could not be sent: GitHub could not be reached. Please try again later.',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('says of a request GitHub did not answer in time that it may have arrived', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    made.issues.failing = { ok: false, reason: 'timeout' };
+    expect(told(await made.run({ text: 'Gone', gym: 'g:2' }))).toBe(
+      'GitHub did not answer in time, so I cannot tell whether your request arrived. Please ' +
+        'ask a moderator before you send it again.',
+    );
+  });
+});
+
+describe('/request: refused before anything is sent', () => {
+  it('without a gym outside a post, naming how to say which', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    const used = await made.run({ text: 'Gone' });
+    expect(used.reply).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
+      content:
+        'Say which gym the request is about with the `gym` option, or use this in the post of ' +
+        'a raid or train at that gym.',
+      flags: MessageFlags.Ephemeral,
+    });
+    expect(used.deferReply).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(made.issues.opened).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('in the post of a meetup, which is at no gym', async () => {
+    const meetup = await createdMeetup();
+    const made = setup({ parties: meetup.store, regions: meetup.regions });
+    const used = await made.run(
+      { text: 'Gone' },
+      { channelId: meetup.postId, thread: { parentId: WEST_FORUM } },
+    );
+    expect(told(used)).toBe(
+      'This meetup is at no gym right now. Say which gym with the `gym` option.',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('for a gym of no region of this server, or text that fits several', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    expect(told(await made.run({ text: 'Gone', gym: '#10' }))).toBe('This server has no gym #10.');
+    expect(told(await made.run({ text: 'Gone', gym: 'starbucks' }))).toMatch(
+      /^Several gyms fit "starbucks": /,
+    );
+    expect(made.issues.opened).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('for blank text', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    expect(told(await made.run({ text: '   ', gym: 'g:2' }))).toBe(
+      'Say what should change about the gym.',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('without using up one of the three requests', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i += 1) await made.run({ text: 'Gone' });
+    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) await made.run({ text: 'Gone', gym: 'g:2' });
+    expect(made.issues.opened).toHaveLength(3);
+    const fourth = await made.run({ text: 'Gone', gym: 'g:2' });
+    expect(told(fourth)).toMatch(/^You can use \/request again in 30 minutes/);
+    expect(made.issues.opened).toHaveLength(3);
+  });
+
+  it('in a DM', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    expect(told(await made.run({ text: 'Gone', gym: 'g:2' }, { isDm: true, guildId: null }))).toBe(
+      'This only works in a server.',
+    );
+  });
+});
+
+describe('/request: the gym option', () => {
+  it('offers the gyms of this server, those of the region first', async () => {
+    const made = setup();
+    const interaction = fakeAutocomplete({
+      commandName: 'request',
+      focusedName: 'gym',
+      focused: 'starbucks',
+      channelId: EAST_CHANNEL,
+      guildChannelNames: SERVER,
+    });
+    await made.router.handle(interaction as never);
+    const offered = (interaction.respond.mock.calls[0]?.[0] ?? []).map((choice) => choice.value);
+    expect(offered).toEqual(['g:9']);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/commands/util/request.ts b/src/commands/util/request.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c7733122602f9bd5912f06f3fea9b1448b5048bc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/commands/util/request.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,160 @@
+import { SlashCommandBuilder, type ChatInputCommandInteraction } from 'discord.js';
+import type { AppContext } from '../../app-context.js';
+import type { Gym } from '../../db/repositories/gym-repository.js';
+import type { Guard, SimpleCommand } from '../../discord/command.js';
+import { UserError } from '../../discord/errors.js';
+import { partyOf, requireGuild } from '../../discord/guards.js';
+import { memberInfo } from '../../discord/member-info.js';
+import type { Throttle } from '../../discord/throttle.js';
+import { isRaid, isTrain, partyWord } from '../../domain/party/party.js';
+import { currentStop } from '../../domain/party/train.js';
+import { gymRequestIssue } from '../../render/gym-request.js';
+import { gymWithId } from '../../render/gym-view.js';
+import type { IssueOutcome } from '../../services/issue-gateway.js';
+import {
+  inServer,
+  respondWithServerGyms,
+  serverGym,
+  serverGymOption,
+  serverOf,
+} from './server-gym.js';
+
+/** Spec row 190: three requests in half an hour, as the legacy bot allowed. */
+export const REQUEST_THROTTLE: Throttle = { uses: 3, perSeconds: 1_800 };
+
+/** The longest request: GitHub takes far more, but a request is a sentence or two. */
+export const MAX_REQUEST = 1_000;
+
+const SAY_WHICH =
+  'Say which gym the request is about with the `gym` option, or use this in the post of a ' +
+  'raid or train at that gym.';
+
+/** The gym of the party whose post the command is used in: a raid's, or a train's stop. */
+async function gymOfPost(interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction, ctx: AppContext): Promise<Gym> {
+  const party = partyOf(interaction, ctx);
+  if (!party) throw new UserError(SAY_WHICH);
+  const gymId = isRaid(party) ? party.gymId : isTrain(party) ? currentStop(party) : undefined;
+  const gym = gymId === null || gymId === undefined ? undefined : ctx.gyms.get(gymId);
+  if (!gym || !inServer(ctx, await serverOf(interaction, ctx))(gym)) {
+    throw new UserError(
+      `This ${partyWord(party)} is at no gym right now. Say which gym with the \`gym\` option.`,
+    );
+  }
+  return gym;
+}
+
+/** The gym a request is about: the `gym` option, or the gym of the post it is made in. */
+async function requestedGym(
+  interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction,
+  ctx: AppContext,
+): Promise<Gym> {
+  const typed = interaction.options.getString('gym');
+  return typed === null || typed.trim() === ''
+    ? gymOfPost(interaction, ctx)
+    : serverGym(ctx, interaction, typed);
+}
+
+/** The words of the request: something, and not too much. */
+function requestText(interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction): string {
+  const text = interaction.options.getString('text', true).trim();
+  if (text === '') throw new UserError('Say what should change about the gym.');
+  if (text.length > MAX_REQUEST) {
+    throw new UserError(`A request has at most ${String(MAX_REQUEST)} characters.`);
+  }
+  return text;
+}
+
+/**
+ * What can be known before anything is sent is refused here, so that a request that came to
+ * nothing does not count against the three of half an hour.
+ */
+const requireRequest: Guard = async (interaction, ctx) => {
+  if (!interaction.isChatInputCommand()) return;
+  requestText(interaction);
+  await requestedGym(interaction, ctx);
+};
+
+/**
+ * What the member is told of a request that was not sent, or may not have been: GitHub may have
+ * opened the issue of a request whose answer did not come in time, and sending it again would
+ * open a second.
+ */
+function failureText(outcome: Extract<IssueOutcome, { ok: false }>): string {
+  switch (outcome.reason) {
+    case 'timeout':
+      return (
+        'GitHub did not answer in time, so I cannot tell whether your request arrived. Please ' +
+        'ask a moderator before you send it again.'
+      );
+    case 'unreachable':
+      return 'Your request could not be sent: GitHub could not be reached. Please try again later.';
+    case 'refused':
+      return (
+        'Your request could not be sent: GitHub refused it. Please tell a moderator, who can ' +
+        'look into the log of the bot.'
+      );
+    case 'disabled':
+      return 'Requests are not set up here. Please tell a moderator.';
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * `/request` (spec row 190, the legacy `!request`): a change a member asks for about a gym (a
+ * wrong name, a gym that is gone, an elite raid gym), sent as an issue to the GitHub repository
+ * of the gym list (`GITHUB_REPO`, with `GITHUB_TOKEN`; the command exists only where both are
+ * set). In the post of a raid or train the gym is that of the party; elsewhere the `gym`
+ * option says which. The member is told privately whether it was sent.
+ */
+export const request: SimpleCommand = {
+  data: new SlashCommandBuilder()
+    .setName('request')
+    .setDescription('Ask for a change to a gym: a wrong name, a gym that is gone, …')
+    .addStringOption((option) =>
+      option
+        .setName('text')
+        .setDescription('What should change')
+        .setRequired(true)
+        .setMaxLength(MAX_REQUEST),
+    )
+    .addStringOption(
+      serverGymOption('The gym; in the post of a raid or train, its gym when left out', false),
+    ),
+  help: {
+    category: 'util',
+    details:
+      'Sends what you write to the people who keep the gym list, as a request about one gym. ' +
+      'In the post of a raid or train it is about the gym of that raid or the stop the train ' +
+      'is at; elsewhere pick the gym with `gym`. Your name and the server go with it, nothing ' +
+      'else of you. Three requests in half an hour at most.',
+    examples: [
+      '/request text:This gym was renamed to Town Hall Fountain',
+      '/request text:The gym is gone gym:Old Stone Fountain',
+    ],
+  },
+  enabled: (config) =>
+    config.env.GITHUB_TOKEN !== undefined && config.env.GITHUB_REPO !== undefined,
+  guards: [requireGuild, requireRequest],
+  defer: 'ephemeral',
+  throttle: REQUEST_THROTTLE,
+  async execute(interaction, ctx) {
+    const text = requestText(interaction);
+    const gym = await requestedGym(interaction, ctx);
+    const outcome = await ctx.issues.open(
+      gymRequestIssue({
+        gym,
+        memberName: memberInfo(interaction).name ?? interaction.user.username,
+        serverName: interaction.guild?.name ?? 'a server',
+        text,
+      }),
+    );
+    if (!outcome.ok) throw new UserError(failureText(outcome));
+    ctx.log.info(
+      { gym: gym.id, member: interaction.user.id, issue: outcome.number },
+      'a member sent a gym request',
+    );
+    await interaction.editReply({
+      content: `Thank you: your request about ${gymWithId(gym)} was sent to the people who keep the gym list.`,
+    });
+  },
+  autocomplete: respondWithServerGyms,
+};

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d1a9df9a0e13bf50312cf924025fa584473b9a18
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/commands/util/server-gym.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  fakeChatInput,
+  sent,
+  type FakeInteraction,
+} from '../../../test/support/fake-interactions.js';
+import { embedOf } from '../../../test/support/gym-commands.js';
+import { testGyms, testRegions, WEST_CHANNEL } from '../../../test/support/gyms.js';
+import { createTestContext } from '../../../test/support/test-context.js';
+import { TEST_SETTINGS_PATH } from '../../../test/support/test-settings.js';
+import { loadSettings } from '../../config/settings.js';
+import { InteractionRouter } from '../../discord/router.js';
+import { GymLookup } from '../../domain/search/gym-lookup.js';
+import { findGym } from './find-gym.js';
+
+/** `/find-gym` over these gyms (the invented ones unless a test changes them), from West. */
+function setup(change: (gyms: ReturnType<typeof testGyms>) => void = () => undefined) {
+  const gyms = testGyms();
+  change(gyms);
+  const { blacklistWords } = loadSettings(TEST_SETTINGS_PATH);
+  const { ctx } = createTestContext({ gyms: new GymLookup(gyms, testRegions(), blacklistWords) });
+  const router = new InteractionRouter(ctx, [findGym], []);
+  return async (gym: string): Promise<FakeInteraction> => {
+    const interaction = fakeChatInput({
+      commandName: 'find-gym',
+      channelId: WEST_CHANNEL,
+      options: { gym },
+    });
+    await router.handle(interaction as never);
+    return interaction;
+  };
+}
+
+const refusal = (used: FakeInteraction) => sent(used.reply).content;
+const title = (used: FakeInteraction) => embedOf(sent(used.editReply)).title;
+
+describe('the gym option of the member commands', () => {
+  it('offers the one gym a misspelt text may mean, without acting on it', async () => {
+    const run = setup();
+    expect(refusal(await run('fountian'))).toBe(
+      'No gym has every word of "fountian"; did you mean **Old Stone Fountain** (#2)? Pick ' +
+        'it from the list, or give its number (`#2`).',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('takes bare digits as the number of a gym of this server', async () => {
+    const run = setup();
+    expect(title(await run('2'))).toBe('Old Stone Fountain');
+    expect(title(await run('#2'))).toBe('Old Stone Fountain');
+    // Gym 10 lies in no region: it is no gym of this server.
+    expect(refusal(await run('10'))).toBe('This server has no gym #10.');
+  });
+
+  it('never acts on a gym whose number only begins with the digits', async () => {
+    const run = setup((gyms) => {
+      const fountain = gyms.find((gym) => gym.id === 2);
+      if (fountain) gyms.push({ ...fountain, id: 1050, name: 'Town Hall Steps', keywords: [] });
+    });
+    expect(refusal(await run('105'))).toBe('This server has no gym #105.');
+    expect(title(await run('1050'))).toBe('Town Hall Steps');
+  });
+
+  it('acts on digits that are no number of a gym but the name of one', async () => {
+    const run = setup((gyms) => {
+      const pier = gyms.find((gym) => gym.id === 5);
+      if (pier) pier.name = 'Pier 77 Starbucks';
+    });
+    expect(title(await run('77'))).toBe('Pier 77 Starbucks');
+  });
+
+  it('names both when the digits are the number of one gym and in the name of another', async () => {
+    const run = setup((gyms) => {
+      const pier = gyms.find((gym) => gym.id === 5);
+      if (pier) pier.name = 'Pier 12 Starbucks';
+    });
+    expect(refusal(await run('12'))).toBe(
+      '"12" is the number of one gym and in the name of another: **Pinewood Post Office Gym** ' +
+        '(#12), **Pier 12 Starbucks** (#5). Pick one from the list, or write the number as `#12`.',
+    );
+    expect(title(await run('#12'))).toBe('Pinewood Post Office Gym');
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/commands/util/server-gym.ts b/src/commands/util/server-gym.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c8f2e38af69d82058ed1c65a920542dda1551c7d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/commands/util/server-gym.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,137 @@
+import type { AutocompleteInteraction, SlashCommandStringOption } from 'discord.js';
+import type { AppContext } from '../../app-context.js';
+import type { Gym } from '../../db/repositories/gym-repository.js';
+import type { LocatedInteraction } from '../../discord/command.js';
+import { UserError } from '../../discord/errors.js';
+import { regionChannelOf } from '../../discord/guards.js';
+import { gymWithId } from '../../render/gym-view.js';
+import { plain, truncate } from '../../render/text.js';
+import { gymRegionsInGuild } from '../../services/region-directory.js';
+import { calledBy } from '../gyms/gym-option.js';
+import { gymChoices, reportedGym } from '../raids/raid-input.js';
+
+/**
+ * The `gym` option of the member commands that name a gym of this server (`/find-gym`,
+ * `/request`): free text with autocomplete, as `/raid`'s.
+ */
+export function serverGymOption(description: string, required: boolean) {
+  return (option: SlashCommandStringOption): SlashCommandStringOption =>
+    option
+      .setName('gym')
+      .setDescription(description)
+      .setRequired(required)
+      .setMaxLength(100)
+      .setAutocomplete(true);
+}
+
+/** `#123`: a gym by its number, as a view of it shows it. */
+const BY_NUMBER = /^#(\d{1,10})$/;
+
+/** The row id of the server an interaction came from; undefined for one the bot has no row of. */
+export async function serverOf(
+  interaction: LocatedInteraction,
+  ctx: AppContext,
+): Promise<number | undefined> {
+  return interaction.guildId === null ? undefined : ctx.guilds.idFor(interaction.guildId);
+}
+
+/** Whether a gym lies in a region of the server: no other server's gym is shown or taken. */
+export function inServer(ctx: AppContext, guildRow: number | undefined): (gym: Gym) => boolean {
+  return (gym) =>
+    guildRow !== undefined && gymRegionsInGuild(ctx.gyms, ctx.regions, gym.id, guildRow).length > 0;
+}
+
+/** Digits alone: the number of a gym of this server, unless another gym is called so. */
+const BARE_NUMBER = /^(\d{1,10})$/;
+
+/**
+ * The gym of this server a `gym` option names: a choice of the list, `#<number>`, digits alone
+ * (as for `/gym`: the number of a gym of this server, unless another gym of it is called by
+ * those digits, when both are named), or text that only one gym of the server has every word
+ * of (`reportedGym`, the region of the channel first). A text that only one gym may mean (a
+ * misspelling) or several gyms fit is answered with them and their numbers, for the member to
+ * pick one; nothing is guessed.
+ */
+export async function serverGym(
+  ctx: AppContext,
+  interaction: LocatedInteraction,
+  typed: string,
+): Promise<Gym> {
+  const accepts = inServer(ctx, await serverOf(interaction, ctx));
+  const text = typed.trim();
+  const quoted = `"${plain(truncate(text, 80))}"`;
+  const number = BY_NUMBER.exec(text)?.[1];
+  if (number !== undefined) {
+    const gym = ctx.gyms.get(Number(number));
+    if (gym && accepts(gym)) return gym;
+    throw new UserError(`This server has no gym #${number}.`);
+  }
+  const digits = BARE_NUMBER.exec(text)?.[1];
+  const numbered = digits === undefined ? undefined : ctx.gyms.get(Number(digits));
+  if (digits !== undefined && numbered && accepts(numbered)) {
+    // Another gym that is called so: the digits are a word of its name, nickname or keywords.
+    const named = ctx.gyms
+      .search(null, digits)
+      .map((hit) => hit.gym)
+      .filter((gym) => gym.id !== numbered.id && accepts(gym) && calledBy(gym, digits));
+    if (named.length === 0) return numbered;
+    throw new UserError(
+      `${quoted} is the number of one gym and in the name of another: ` +
+        `${[numbered, ...named].map((gym) => gymWithId(gym)).join(', ')}. Pick one from the ` +
+        `list, or write the number as \`#${digits}\`.`,
+    );
+  }
+  // Digits that are no number of a gym here are text, but only for gyms called by them: the
+  // search also finds a gym by the beginning of its number (`105` finds gym 1050), which is not
+  // a gym called so (as for `/gym`).
+  const found = reportedGym(
+    ctx,
+    regionChannelOf(interaction, ctx),
+    text,
+    digits === undefined ? accepts : (gym) => accepts(gym) && calledBy(gym, digits),
+  );
+  if (found.kind === 'gym') return found.gym;
+  if (found.kind === 'none' && digits !== undefined) {
+    throw new UserError(`This server has no gym #${digits}.`);
+  }
+  if (found.kind === 'none') {
+    throw new UserError(
+      `I found no gym of this server for ${quoted}. Type part of its name and pick it from the ` +
+        'list.',
+    );
+  }
+  const [only] = found.gyms;
+  if (only && found.gyms.length === 1) {
+    throw new UserError(
+      `No gym has every word of ${quoted}; did you mean ${gymWithId(only)}? Pick it from the ` +
+        `list, or give its number (\`#${String(only.id)}\`).`,
+    );
+  }
+  throw new UserError(
+    `Several gyms fit ${quoted}: ${found.gyms.map((gym) => gymWithId(gym)).join(', ')}. Pick ` +
+      'one from the list, or give its number (`#123`).',
+  );
+}
+
+/** The choices of the `gym` option: the gyms of this server, the region's own first. */
+export async function respondWithServerGyms(
+  interaction: AutocompleteInteraction,
+  ctx: AppContext,
+): Promise<void> {
+  const focused = interaction.options.getFocused(true);
+  if (focused.name !== 'gym') {
+    await interaction.respond([]);
+    return;
+  }
+  const regionName = (channelId: string): string | undefined =>
+    interaction.guild?.channels.cache.get(channelId)?.name;
+  await interaction.respond(
+    gymChoices(
+      ctx,
+      regionChannelOf(interaction, ctx),
+      String(focused.value),
+      regionName,
+      inServer(ctx, await serverOf(interaction, ctx)),
+    ),
+  );
+}
diff --git a/src/render/gym-request.test.ts b/src/render/gym-request.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a8a60e98634dcc37bdf077a44bd636ef81ef78be
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/render/gym-request.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { MAX_ISSUE_TITLE } from '../services/issue-gateway.js';
+import { gymRequestIssue, noGitHubMentions } from './gym-request.js';
+
+/** No half of a character in a text: no code point among the surrogates. */
+const wellFormed = (text: string): boolean =>
+  [...text].every((char) => {
+    const code = char.codePointAt(0) ?? 0;
+    return code < 0xd800 || code > 0xdfff;
+  });
+
+describe('gymRequestIssue', () => {
+  it('names the gym in the title and labels the issue with its number', () => {
+    expect(
+      gymRequestIssue({
+        gym: { id: 12, name: 'Pinewood Post Office Gym' },
+        memberName: 'Alice',
+        serverName: 'Pinewood Raids',
+        text: 'Gone since May\n\nSee the photo',
+      }),
+    ).toEqual({
+      title: 'Gym request: Pinewood Post Office Gym (#12)',
+      body: 'Request from `Alice` in `Pinewood Raids`:\n\nGone since May\n\nSee the photo',
+      labels: ['12'],
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('keeps control and direction characters out of the title, and never leaves it without a name', () => {
+    const issue = (name: string) =>
+      gymRequestIssue({ gym: { id: 3, name }, memberName: 'A', serverName: 'S', text: 'T' }).title;
+    expect(issue('Old\u202e Mill\u0007')).toBe('Gym request: Old Mill (#3)');
+    expect(issue('\u200e')).toBe('Gym request: Gym (#3)');
+  });
+
+  it('cuts a long name, never the number, and never inside a character', () => {
+    const issue = (name: string) =>
+      gymRequestIssue({ gym: { id: 1234567, name }, memberName: 'A', serverName: 'S', text: 'T' })
+        .title;
+    for (const name of ['x'.repeat(300), '\u{1F3DB}'.repeat(300)]) {
+      const title = issue(name);
+      expect(title.endsWith('… (#1234567)')).toBe(true);
+      expect([...title]).toHaveLength(MAX_ISSUE_TITLE);
+      expect(wellFormed(title)).toBe(true);
+    }
+  });
+});
+
+describe('noGitHubMentions', () => {
+  it('breaks every @ and #, so that nobody is notified and no issue is linked', () => {
+    expect(noGitHubMentions('@octocat and @org/team, mail@example.com, see #12')).toBe(
+      '@\u200boctocat and @\u200borg/team, mail@\u200bexample.com, see #\u200b12',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('breaks GH-<number>, which GitHub links to an issue too', () => {
+    expect(noGitHubMentions('see GH-12 and gh-3, but not GH-x')).toBe(
+      'see GH-\u200b12 and gh-\u200b3, but not GH-x',
+    );
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the names in an issue', () => {
+  it('fall back to a word when nothing but backticks is left of them', () => {
+    const issue = gymRequestIssue({
+      gym: { id: 2, name: 'Old Stone Fountain' },
+      memberName: '``',
+      serverName: ' ` ',
+      text: 'Gone',
+    });
+    expect(issue.body).toBe('Request from someone in a server:\n\nGone');
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/render/gym-request.ts b/src/render/gym-request.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..6cae1ecc2a1301b5e787c12f142754ddfdb1ec30
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/render/gym-request.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+import { tidyLine } from '../domain/gyms/gym-text.js';
+import { codePointsOf, MAX_ISSUE_TITLE, type NewIssue } from '../services/issue-gateway.js';
+
+/** A zero-width space: what breaks a mention or a reference on GitHub without showing. */
+const BREAK = '\u200b';
+
+/**
+ * Text for GitHub that pings and links nothing there: GitHub renders the body of an issue as
+ * Markdown, notifies whoever an `@name` names (a person or a team) and links `#12` to an issue
+ * of the repository (as it does `GH-12`), so a zero-width space follows every `@` and `#` and
+ * the `GH-` before a number. The text reads the same. Nothing else is escaped: GitHub shows what
+ * a member typed as they typed it, and a backslash would show.
+ */
+export function noGitHubMentions(text: string): string {
+  return text.replace(/[@#]/g, `$&${BREAK}`).replace(/\bGH-(?=\d)/gi, `$&${BREAK}`);
+}
+
+/**
+ * A name in the body of an issue: as code (backticks taken out of it first), so that nothing in
+ * it is read as Markdown, and pinging nobody; `fallback` when nothing is left of it (an empty
+ * code span shows as backticks).
+ */
+function asCode(name: string, fallback: string): string {
+  const text = name.replace(/`/g, '').trim();
+  return text === '' ? fallback : `\`${noGitHubMentions(text)}\``;
+}
+
+/** What `/request` puts into an issue: who asked, from which server, about which gym. */
+export interface GymRequest {
+  gym: { id: number; name: string };
+  /** The member's display name: no id of a member goes to GitHub. */
+  memberName: string;
+  serverName: string;
+  /** What the member wrote, as typed. */
+  text: string;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The issue of a gym request (spec row 190): titled `Gym request: <name> (#<id>)`, with the
+ * member's words in the body under who sent them from where, and the gym's number as its
+ * label. The title is text on GitHub (no Markdown): the name is only tidied of control and
+ * direction characters (`tidyLine`), and cut (by whole characters) so that the number always
+ * stays within GitHub's limit.
+ */
+export function gymRequestIssue(request: GymRequest): NewIssue {
+  const { gym } = request;
+  const prefix = 'Gym request: ';
+  const suffix = ` (#${String(gym.id)})`;
+  const room = MAX_ISSUE_TITLE - codePointsOf(prefix).length - codePointsOf(suffix).length;
+  const whole = codePointsOf(tidyLine(gym.name) || 'Gym');
+  const name = whole.length <= room ? whole.join('') : `${whole.slice(0, room - 1).join('')}…`;
+  return {
+    title: `${prefix}${name}${suffix}`,
+    body:
+      `Request from ${asCode(request.memberName, 'someone')} in ` +
+      `${asCode(request.serverName, 'a server')}:\n\n${noGitHubMentions(request.text)}`,
+    labels: [String(gym.id)],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/src/services/issue-gateway.test.ts b/src/services/issue-gateway.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d3f7dd53bba324f91025e34a76505e812b1b41c4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/services/issue-gateway.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,113 @@
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { createTestLogger } from '../../test/support/test-logger.js';
+import {
+  GitHubIssues,
+  MAX_ISSUE_TITLE,
+  type IssueFetch,
+  type IssueResponse,
+} from './issue-gateway.js';
+
+/** No half of a character in a text: no code point among the surrogates. */
+const wellFormed = (text: string): boolean =>
+  [...text].every((char) => {
+    const code = char.codePointAt(0) ?? 0;
+    return code < 0xd800 || code > 0xdfff;
+  });
+
+const TOKEN = 'ghp_secret-test-token';
+const ISSUE = { title: 'Gym request: Old Stone Fountain (#2)', body: 'Text', labels: ['2'] };
+
+function reply(status: number, body: unknown = {}): IssueResponse {
+  return {
+    status,
+    json: () => Promise.resolve(body),
+    body: { cancel: () => Promise.resolve() },
+  };
+}
+
+function setup(
+  answer: () => Promise<IssueResponse>,
+  options: { token?: string; repo?: string } = {},
+) {
+  const { log, entries } = createTestLogger();
+  const fetch = vi.fn<IssueFetch>(answer);
+  const issues = new GitHubIssues({
+    token: 'token' in options ? options.token : TOKEN,
+    repo: 'repo' in options ? options.repo : 'pine-owner/pine-gyms',
+    fetch,
+    log,
+  });
+  /** Everything that was logged, as one text, to look for the token in. */
+  const logged = () => JSON.stringify(entries);
+  return { issues, fetch, entries, logged };
+}
+
+describe('GitHubIssues', () => {
+  it('opens an issue in the repository with the token in the header', async () => {
+    const made = setup(() =>
+      Promise.resolve(reply(201, { number: 42, html_url: 'https://x.test/42' })),
+    );
+    expect(await made.issues.open(ISSUE)).toEqual({ ok: true, number: 42 });
+    const [url, init] = made.fetch.mock.calls[0] ?? [];
+    expect(url).toBe('https://api.github.com/repos/pine-owner/pine-gyms/issues');
+    expect(init?.method).toBe('POST');
+    expect(init?.redirect).toBe('error');
+    expect(init?.headers).toMatchObject({
+      Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}`,
+      Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
+      'User-Agent': 'Professor-Pine',
+    });
+    expect(JSON.parse(init?.body ?? '')).toEqual(ISSUE);
+    expect(init?.signal).toBeInstanceOf(AbortSignal);
+    expect(made.logged()).not.toContain(TOKEN);
+  });
+
+  it('cuts a title to what GitHub takes, never inside a character', async () => {
+    const made = setup(() => Promise.resolve(reply(201, { number: 1 })));
+    await made.issues.open({ ...ISSUE, title: 'x'.repeat(300) });
+    await made.issues.open({ ...ISSUE, title: String.fromCodePoint(0x1f3db).repeat(300) });
+    const titles = made.fetch.mock.calls.map(
+      ([, init]) => (JSON.parse(init.body) as { title: string }).title,
+    );
+    for (const title of titles) {
+      expect([...title]).toHaveLength(MAX_ISSUE_TITLE);
+      expect(wellFormed(title)).toBe(true);
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('counts an issue GitHub created as opened, also when its answer cannot be read', async () => {
+    const made = setup(() =>
+      Promise.resolve({ status: 201, json: () => Promise.reject(new Error('not JSON')) }),
+    );
+    expect(await made.issues.open(ISSUE)).toEqual({ ok: true, number: undefined });
+  });
+
+  it('answers a refusal with its status, and logs neither the token nor what GitHub said', async () => {
+    const made = setup(() => Promise.resolve(reply(401, { message: `Bad credentials ${TOKEN}` })));
+    expect(await made.issues.open(ISSUE)).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'refused', status: 401 });
+    expect(made.logged()).toContain('401');
+    expect(made.logged()).not.toContain(TOKEN);
+    expect(made.logged()).not.toContain('Bad credentials');
+  });
+
+  it('answers a timeout and an unreachable GitHub without throwing', async () => {
+    const timedOut = setup(() =>
+      Promise.reject(new DOMException('The operation timed out.', 'TimeoutError')),
+    );
+    expect(await timedOut.issues.open(ISSUE)).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'timeout' });
+    const unreachable = setup(() =>
+      Promise.reject(new TypeError('fetch failed', { cause: new Error('getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND') })),
+    );
+    expect(await unreachable.issues.open(ISSUE)).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'unreachable' });
+    expect(unreachable.logged()).toContain('ENOTFOUND');
+  });
+
+  it('asks nothing without a token or a repository', async () => {
+    for (const options of [{ token: undefined }, { repo: undefined }, { token: '' }]) {
+      const made = setup(() => Promise.resolve(reply(201)), options);
+      expect(made.issues.enabled).toBe(false);
+      expect(await made.issues.open(ISSUE)).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'disabled' });
+      expect(made.fetch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    }
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/services/issue-gateway.ts b/src/services/issue-gateway.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..fdd92ebbc215d58ef60ba47625bbb1be75f00180
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/services/issue-gateway.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,134 @@
+import { z } from 'zod';
+import type { Logger } from '../log.js';
+import { failureReason } from './failure-reason.js';
+
+/** An issue to open: GitHub takes the title as text and renders the body as Markdown. */
+export interface NewIssue {
+  title: string;
+  body: string;
+  labels: readonly string[];
+}
+
+/**
+ * What came of opening an issue: its number when the answer could be read (an issue GitHub
+ * created is open, whatever else its answer said). `disabled`: no token or repository is
+ * configured. `refused`: GitHub answered with an error status (`status`). `timeout`,
+ * `unreachable`: no answer came, and nothing is known of the issue.
+ */
+export type IssueOutcome =
+  | { ok: true; number: number | undefined }
+  | { ok: false; reason: 'disabled' | 'refused' | 'timeout' | 'unreachable'; status?: number };
+
+/**
+ * Where `/request` sends what members ask of the gym list: the issues of a GitHub repository.
+ * Nothing here throws: a failure is an answer. Tests use `FakeIssues` (`test/support/issues.ts`);
+ * nothing in a test touches the network.
+ */
+export interface IssueGateway {
+  /** False when no token or repository is configured. */
+  readonly enabled: boolean;
+  open(issue: NewIssue): Promise<IssueOutcome>;
+}
+
+/** What is used of GitHub's answer. */
+export interface IssueResponse {
+  status: number;
+  json(): Promise<unknown>;
+  body?: { cancel(): Promise<void> } | null;
+}
+
+export type IssueFetch = (
+  url: string,
+  init: {
+    method: 'POST';
+    headers: Record<string, string>;
+    body: string;
+    redirect: 'error';
+    signal: AbortSignal;
+  },
+) => Promise<IssueResponse>;
+
+export interface GitHubIssuesOptions {
+  /** `GITHUB_TOKEN`: a secret, only ever in the request's header. */
+  token: string | undefined;
+  /** `GITHUB_REPO`, `owner/repo`. */
+  repo: string | undefined;
+  fetch: IssueFetch;
+  log: Logger;
+  /** How long opening an issue may take. Default ten seconds. */
+  timeoutMs?: number;
+}
+
+/** GitHub's API; the version its documentation names for this request. */
+const GITHUB_API = 'https://api.github.com';
+const API_VERSION = '2022-11-28';
+/** GitHub refuses a title of more characters than this. */
+export const MAX_ISSUE_TITLE = 256;
+
+/** The characters of a text, whole: a cut between them never leaves half of one. */
+export function codePointsOf(text: string): string[] {
+  return [...text];
+}
+
+const createdIssue = z.object({ number: z.number().int().positive() });
+
+/**
+ * Opens issues through GitHub's REST API (`POST /repos/<repo>/issues`) with a token. The token
+ * is in the `Authorization` header and nowhere else: never logged, never in a sentence. What a
+ * failure says is logged with its status only (GitHub's message can quote the request).
+ */
+export class GitHubIssues implements IssueGateway {
+  private readonly timeoutMs: number;
+
+  constructor(private readonly options: GitHubIssuesOptions) {
+    this.timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 10_000;
+  }
+
+  get enabled(): boolean {
+    return Boolean(this.options.token) && Boolean(this.options.repo);
+  }
+
+  async open(issue: NewIssue): Promise<IssueOutcome> {
+    const { token, repo, log } = this.options;
+    if (!this.enabled || token === undefined || repo === undefined) {
+      return { ok: false, reason: 'disabled' };
+    }
+    let response: IssueResponse;
+    try {
+      response = await this.options.fetch(`${GITHUB_API}/repos/${repo}/issues`, {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: {
+          Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
+          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
+          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+          'User-Agent': 'Professor-Pine',
+          'X-GitHub-Api-Version': API_VERSION,
+        },
+        body: JSON.stringify({
+          title: codePointsOf(issue.title).slice(0, MAX_ISSUE_TITLE).join(''),
+          body: issue.body,
+          labels: issue.labels,
+        }),
+        redirect: 'error',
+        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(this.timeoutMs),
+      });
+    } catch (err) {
+      const timeout = err instanceof Error && err.name === 'TimeoutError';
+      log.warn(
+        { reason: timeout ? 'timeout' : failureReason(err) },
+        'could not open an issue on GitHub',
+      );
+      return { ok: false, reason: timeout ? 'timeout' : 'unreachable' };
+    }
+    if (response.status !== 201) {
+      // What GitHub says of a refusal is of no use to the member: let go of it unread.
+      void response.body?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);
+      log.warn({ status: response.status }, 'GitHub refused to open an issue');
+      return { ok: false, reason: 'refused', status: response.status };
+    }
+    const parsed = createdIssue.safeParse(await response.json().catch(() => undefined));
+    const number = parsed.success ? parsed.data.number : undefined;
+    log.info({ issue: number }, 'opened an issue on GitHub');
+    return { ok: true, number };
+  }
+}
diff --git a/test/support/fake-interactions.ts b/test/support/fake-interactions.ts
index aa6e928d46f108399278c2d409cda84d9f723ff2..8dee77d93579badfd4a58d6e2ef41c99262e7867 100644
--- a/test/support/fake-interactions.ts
+++ b/test/support/fake-interactions.ts
@@ -23,6 +23,8 @@ export interface FakeOptions {

diff --git a/test/support/issues.ts b/test/support/issues.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a08af1985ab1765df2ef308814197b4482a99599
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/support/issues.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+import type { IssueGateway, IssueOutcome, NewIssue } from '../../src/services/issue-gateway.js';
+
+/**
+ * GitHub's issues as a test wants them: nothing leaves the process. Every issue is recorded in
+ * `opened` and answered with the next number, unless `failing` gives the answer of a failure.
+ * Like the real one it never throws and never answers in the same turn of the event loop.
+ */
+export class FakeIssues implements IssueGateway {
+  enabled = true;
+  failing: Extract<IssueOutcome, { ok: false }> | undefined;
+  readonly opened: NewIssue[] = [];
+  private next = 1;
+
+  open(issue: NewIssue): Promise<IssueOutcome> {
+    const answer: IssueOutcome = this.failing ?? { ok: true, number: this.next };
+    if (answer.ok) {
+      this.opened.push(issue);
+      this.next += 1;
+    }
+    return new Promise((resolve) => {
+      setImmediate(() => {
+        resolve(answer);
+      });
+    });
+  }
+}

## After the last task

The controller, not an implementer, does these:

1. `git diff proto/phase-6a HEAD -- src test scripts .env.example` prints nothing; `npm run check`, `npm run build` and `npm run test:db`, each once and one after the other.
2. Whole-branch review (Opus, high effort); one fix wave if it finds something.
3. `CLAUDE.md` (status, conventions: `src/domain/pvp/`, `evolutions` and `evolutionLine`, `ctx.issues`, `server-gym.ts`, `MEMBER_READ_THROTTLE`, `settings.regionMapLink`), the follow-ups ("From Phase 6A"), the Gantt chart and memory.

## Staging checklist (with Matt, on the test application and server)

Nothing of this plan has touched Discord. Each step needs Matt's go-ahead. `npm run deploy-commands -- --guild <test server>` first (five new commands; `/rank` and `/maps` also in DMs only through a global registration, which is Matt's call). No migration; the first start downloads the game data again (version 5). `settings.regionMapLink` must be set for `/maps`; `GITHUB_TOKEN` (Issues write and push access) and `GITHUB_REPO` for `/request`.
